notes.title: Dungeon Souls Development Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gz54RWC.png[/img]
Hey everyone! Some of you are probably wondering why hasn't there been any recent update to the game (having into account the update frequency). We, the Dungeon Souls team and Lamina Studios team, have something to tell you. We're currently undergoing some internal changes in the company.

[h1]What Is This About?[/h1]

Due to internal changes that are being made in the company, the development progress of Dungeon Souls has become quite slow (and is expected to keep like this for at least a month or two). As such, no updates will probably occur between the writing of this news and the 1-2 months time frame. We do know that some of you will be upset when reading this (since we have been reading the Steam discussions and emails sent about bugs, suggestions and feedback in general), but we can only apologize for the upcoming small hiatus in updates and ask you for your understanding and patience. We would also like to take this time to appreciate all ongoing support that you've shown for the game, as we feel that, no matter how many times we do express it, it is never enough! In all honesty, the player base is what is supporting the development of the game and the addition of new features (if it weren't for you guys and gals, we doubt we've had added any features or updates since 2017), so thank you for the support!

[h1]That's Great And All But What About The Issues And Features Of The Game That Still Need To Be Tackled?[/h1]

As stated previously, we've been paying attention to the feedback you've been given, from issues to suggestions. Some of the most worrying aspects are as follows:

[list]
[*]Items for those players who signed the sign board and helped with the game during its pre-release
[*]Modding support fixes and functionalities
[*]Controller support (bugs, adaptation to certain OS, removal of "clunky" feeling to the controls)
[*]Local co-op (bugs related with local co-op functionality of the game)
[/list]

In regard to the list above, these issues will be worked on and have not been forgotten. However, their development is currently slower than what would be desirable.


[h1]In Sum[/h1]
We, as a team, decided it would be best to inform you of the small hiatus in updates. We do not have the intetion to say that the game won't be developed at all with this message. Our goal is simply to inform you, as a player, that the next update will take a long time before it arrives and to hang on and bear with us!

Thank you for your patience and understanding in advance,
From the Dungeon Souls and Lamina Studios team.

notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.1.1 - Modding Hotfix
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ssaSLS4.png[/img]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This hotfix fixes some bugs reported for patch 1.1.

[h1]Mac Users[/h1]

	We are currently having issues exporting to Mac. This update is not available for Mac. Please be patient until we can fix them.

[h1]DSEditor[/h1]

	We have updated the modding editor. You can download via this [url=https://laminastudios.com/files/DSEditor.zip]link[/url].

[h1]Bug Fixes & Feedback Changes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[b]Game Bugs[/b]
	[list]
		[*][b]Back From Vacations -[/b] Fixed a bug where Judgement level would not appear.
		[*]Fixed a bug where Herberk's Pendant would get replaced by Destroyer's Hammer.
		[*]Fixed a bug where picking active items would make every other item turn into the picked up item.
	[/list]
	
	[b]Modding Editor Bugs[/b]
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where files wouldn't get deleted.
		[*]Fixed a typo on the documentation of "getPlayerAttribute" and "setPlayerAttribute" in regards to the maximum hp.
	[/list]
	
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	[list]
		[*]In some systems (both operative system and hardware components), the game has severe lags spikes for brief periods of time. This usually has to do with malfunctioning input devices, but a fix is being developed. If this occurs to you, please send an email to laminastudios@gmail.com with the operative system you have and hardware, as well as any relevant information (the time you were playing at and what were you doing).
		[*]Currently, to some players, Steam functionalities are not working under Linux systems, as well as a few in-game functionalities (such as minimap). We are working into resolving this issue.
		[*]During co-op, heroes have a different currency than the one specified on the HUD, resulting in some characters being able to buy certain items that the other player can't (due to gold spent). This will be fixed in a future patch.
	[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.1 - Modding Support
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AEW6ZVh.png[/img]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This update brings hero balancing to the game (with updated abilities), as well as modding support and re-make of voice lines!

[h1]Modding Support[/h1]
	
	We have added modding support for Dungeon Souls! Hurray! ːsteamhappyː
	
	Currently, the modding feature is limited to items only, but if players like it a lot and we start seeing quite the engagement, more features are to come! Here is a small roadmap of what we have planned for modding support, in case the community wants more of it:
	[list]
	[*]Enemies
	[*]Pets
	[*]Arcane Forge
	[*]Dungeon Levels
	[*]Traps
	[/list]
	
	Check out the [url=http://dungeon-souls.wikia.com/wiki/Modding]Dungeon Souls Wikia[/url] for more information, as well as the game's Steam Workshop page!

[h1]DSEditor[/h1]

You can download the Dungeon Souls Editor via this [url=https://laminastudios.com/files/DSEditor.zip]link[/url]
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	[b]Redeemer[/b]
		Changed Redeemer's behaviour due to feedback concerning the amount of time available in a dungeon before Redeemer appeared. On easy and normal difficulties, redeemer will take twice the amount of time to appear (x2 multiplier). Also, the base amount of time it takes for the Redeemer to appear has been increased by over 60%. 

	[b]Voice Acting[/b]
		Changed both Skeleton King's and Slime Gargantulum's voice lines! We've also changed Slime Gargantulum's voice and revamped Skeleton King's!
	
[h1]Hero Balancing[/h1]
	
	We've taken a look into the feedback obtained from the hero balancing survey! From an analysis, we found out that every hero seems to be both over powered and under powered (suggesting that it depends on the player's play style). However, there were some heroes who were more "unfairly" under powered when compared with other heroes. We also observed general feedback in regard to abilities and cooldowns. As such, here is our hero balancing update! We hope you guys like it! ːsteamhappyː

	[h1]Passives[/h1]
		At max passive level (and, proportionally, all levels below):
		[list]
		[*]Changed passive health from 75% to 50%.
		[*]Changed passive damage from 40% to 30%
		[*]Changed passive crit from 25% to 20%
		[*]Changed passive defense from 150% to 120%
		[*]Changed passive resist from 140% to 120%
		[/list]

	[h1]Barbarian[/h1]

		[b]Thunder Axe[/b]
		Increased shockwave scaling damage from 10+(5 per skill level) physical damage and 90+(10 per skill level) magical damage to 70+(10 per skill level) physical damage and 60+(10 per skill level) magical damage.

		[b]Cooldowns[/b]
		Changed Shout of Rage's cooldown from 15 seconds to 10.
		Changed Thunder Axe's cooldown from 18 seconds to 4.

		[h1]Archer[/h1]

		[b]Cooldowns[/b]
		Changed Pentuple Arrow's cooldown from 12 seconds to 10.
		Changed Rain of Arrows' cooldown from 18 seconds to 6.

	[h1]Thief[/h1]
		[b]Stats[/b]

		[list]
		[*]Increased base hp by 10.
		[/list]

		[b][strike]Thief Bomb[/strike][/b] changed to [b][u](NEW)[/u]Dagger Flurry:[/b]

		Throws an empowered dagger at up to 6+(1 per skill level) nearby enemies, dealing 150+(40 per skill level) physical damage.

		[b]Cooldowns[/b]
		Changed Invisibility's cooldown from 14 seconds to 8.

	[h1]Wizard[/h1]
		[b]Stats[/b]

		[list]
		[*]Increased base hp by 20.
		[*]Increased base magic resist by 1.
		[/list]

		[b]Duplicate[/b]
		Now creates a flash fire that deals 80+(30 per skill level) magical damage to nearby enemies.

		[b]Cooldowns[/b]
		Changed basic attack cooldown from 1 second to 0.8 seconds.
		Changed Duplicate's cooldown from 14 seconds to 6.

	[h1]Cleric[/h1]
		[b]Stats[/b]
		Increased base hp by 20

		[b]Holy Gate[/b]
		Now grants split projectiles +20+(10 per skill level)% extra magic damage.

		[b]Regeneration[/b]
		Now instantly heals for 20+(20 per skill level) and grants 10+(2 per skill level) health regeneration each 3 seconds.
		Reduced cooldown from 15 seconds to 12.

	[h1]Necromancer[/h1]

		[b]Blood for Attack[/b]
		Now adds 50+(30 per skill level)% physical damage and 50+(10 per skill level)% magic damage, but consumes 10+(5 per skill level)% health per basic attack and reduces health regen by 75%

	[h1]NightBlade[/h1]

		[b]Thick Armour[/b]
		Grants 50+(10 per skill level) defense for 3 seconds, during which nightblade starts expelling energy. After the 3 seconds, thick armour explodes, dealing 120+(20 per skill level)% physical and 120(+20 per skill level)% magical damage to nearby enemies.

		[b]Weapon Switch[/b]

		Changed the effect so that the first 2+(2 per skill level) strikes deal the extra damage.

	[h1]Engineer[/h1]

		[b]Stats[/b]
		Increased movement speed by 0.1

		[b]March my Beauties![/b]
		Fixed a bug where damage was being multiplied by bonus damage.

	
[h1]Items[/h1]
		
		[h1]Sign Board[/h1]
			
			[b]([u]NEW[/u])Zior's Wisdom[/b]

			[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] +2 skill points. Permanently unlocks modding support when picked up.
			[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Legendary Craftable
			[b][i]Item Stacks[/i]:[/b] 1
			[b][i]Steam User[/i]:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth/]Zior[/url]
			
		[h1]Ingredients[/h1]

		[b]([u]NEW[/u])Zior's Fragment[/b] - A shard with the essence of the wind. Obtained when completing the game's story.
		
		[h1]Recipes[/h1]

		[b]([u]NEW[/u])Zior's Wisdom Recipe[/b]
			[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Legendary.

[h1]Bug Fixes & Feedback Changes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[b]Bugs[/b]
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where redeemer would spawn in boss rooms.
		[*]Fixed a bug where Slime Gargantulum would stop attacking after using certain abilities.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the active items rocket and missile could crash upon use.
		[*]Fixed a bug where difficulty was not being quicksaved.
	[/list]
	
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	[list]
		[*]In some systems (both operative system and hardware components), the game has severe lags spikes for brief periods of time. This usually has to do with malfunctioning input devices, but a fix is being developed. If this occurs to you, please send an email to support@laminastudios.com with the operative system you have and hardware, as well as any relevant information (the time you were playing at and what were you doing).
		[*]Currently, to some players, Steam functionalities are not working under Linux systems, as well as a few in-game functionalities (such as minimap). We are working into resolving this issue.
		[*]During co-op, heroes have a different currency than the one specified on the HUD, resulting in some characters being able to buy certain items that the other player can't (due to gold spent). This will be fixed in a future patch.
	[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.0.5.5
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qj4wCEl.png[/img]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This small update brings some patches to the game and addresses a request we did to the community.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	
	[h1]Redeemer[/h1]
		Changed Redeemer's summon behaviour. Now, the redeemer will appear after a certain amount of time has passed (more than enough to complete the level), regardless of the number of activated marks. It will also appear after activating the final mark.

		This change derived from a review requested by players, since the Redeemer's purpose in the game wasn't obvious (since you could grind on a level for ever, as long as the last mark remained unactive). Special thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198025241592]Einko[/url] for his suggestion on the matter!
	
[h1]Items[/h1]
		
		[b]Sign Board[/b]
			A little bit of a more personal note here: about a year ago, we requested players that helped with the game's alpha and beta stages to sign a Sign Board, since we had a surprise stored. However, we took a long time to reply to this surprise (even though the original intent never changed, which was personal custom items named after the players) and we'd like to apologize for the time it has taken! In the next patches, ALL people that signed the board up until now will get an item in the game named after them.
			
			We will continue doing and extend this rewarding behaviour to any players we see are worthy of it, being dependent on factors such as their participation in the game, engagement with the community and overall support for the game! ːsteamhappyː
			
			Some of the items have descriptions and effects determined by us. However, if any of the item's author does not like its item's effect, please email us so that we change it accordingly ːsteamhappyː
			
			And now, here follows the first batch of items:
			
			[b]([u]NEW[/u])Brontolo's Sight[/b]

			[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] +40% Accuracy. Can see enemies in entire room.
			[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare
			[b][i]Item Stacks[/i]:[/b] 1
			[b][i]Steam User[/i]:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198127911704/]Brontolo[/url]
			
			
			[b]([u]NEW[/u])SeekNDestroy Missile[/b]

			[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] On attack, 20/30/40% chance to launch a missile that deals 40/60/80 damage.
			[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare
			[b][i]Item Stacks[/i]:[/b] 3
			[b][i]Steam User[/i]:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/adrianzx4]SeekNDestroy[/url]
			
			[b]([u]NEW[/u])Daniel Novak (DaxThorn)'s Gem[/b]

			[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] +10/15% experience gained
			[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare
			[b][i]Item Stacks[/i]:[/b] 2
			[b][i]Steam User[/i]:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/daxthorn]DaxThorn[/url]
			
			[b]([u]NEW[/u])Xgpmcnp Cookie Totem[/b]

			[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b]Transforms projectiles into cookies. +2 mixed damage. 
			[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
			[b][i]Item Stacks[/i]:[/b] 1
			[b][i]Steam User[/i]:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Xgpmcnp]Xgpmcnp[/url]
			
			[b]([u]NEW[/u])Austinlb90's Amber[/b]

			[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] +8/10/12 mixed defense.
			[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
			[b][i]Item Stacks[/i]:[/b] 3
			[b][i]Steam User[/i]:[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198177922821]Austinlb90[/url]

[h1]Bug Fixes & Feedback Changes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[h1]Bugs[/h1]
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where the ending cutscenes were being displayed without having freed all heroes.
		[*][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Added a temporary fix mechanism to the Out-Of-Map issue. Now, when out of bounds, if the player exceeds a square area around the map, the player will be teleported back to the dungeon's door.
		[*][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Fixed a bug, in internal tests, where difficulty would not unlock. notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.0.5.3 - Christmas Event
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/krdIWp1.png[/img]
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This update brings some fixes and feedback changes, as well as a christmas adventure for the holidays!

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	
[h1]Events[/h1]
		[h1]([u]NEW[/u])Christmas Event[/h1]
			The christmas event has just arrived! From the 22nd to the 28th of Decemeber, you will be able to play the special game mode in the Frozen Land! This mode will have you saving good children from naughty, demon children sent by Judgement! After rescueing each child, you'll take on Santa's job by awarding them a present!
			
		[b]Objective:[/b]
			Save the children from the demons and gift them presents.
			
		[b]Reward:[/b]
			Christmas Event Recipes and ingredients.
		
		[b]Accessability:[/b]
			You can access the [b]Frozen Land[/b] via the [b]orange, santa-hatted teleporter[/b]. The teleporter will appear in the ice level. It will not spawn in a boss room.
		
		[b]Duration:[/b]
			The event lasts from the 22nd of december to the 28th of december.
	
	[h1]Pets[/h1]
		
		[b]([u]NEW[/u])(PET) Snowy[/b]

		[b][i]Pet Description[/i]:[/b] 
			[list]
				[*]Has 4% of owner's mixed damage.
				[*]Slows target enemy by 40%
			[/list]
		[b][i]Pet Class[/i]:[/b] Legendary
		
		
		[b]([u]NEW[/u])(PET) Gingerbread Bud[/b]

		[b][i]Pet Description[/i]:[/b] 
			[list]
				[*]Has 5% of owner's mixed damage.
				[*]Grants owner +5% of experience earned.
			[/list]
		[b][i]Pet Class[/i]:[/b] Legendary
		
	[h1]Items[/h1]
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Golden Star[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Grants +25% experience gained and +50% ingredient amount obtained.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Legendary Equipable
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Mistletoe[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] When hitting an enemy near another enemy, gives 5% chance to stun both for 1.5 seconds.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare Equipable
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Mystery Present Box[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Drops a random rare item when picked up.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare Equipable
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Hot Choco[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] When activated, gives increased movement speed and attack speed for 5 seconds. (Thanks, SantaDoge! ːsteamhappyː)
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare Equipable
	
		
	[h1]Ingredients[/h1]

	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Gingerbread[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Snowflake[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Cocoa Beans[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Sugar[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain demon children and props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Stardust[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Mistletoe Leaf[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Drupe[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Red Wool[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Paper Drafts[/b] - Used to craft several Christmas items. Dropped by certain props.
	
	

	[h1]Recipes[/h1]

	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Golden Star Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Legendary.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Snowy Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Legendary.

	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Gingerbread Bud Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Legendary.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Mistletoe Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Rare.
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Mystery Present Box Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Rare.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Hot Choco Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Rare.

[h1]Bug Fixes & Feedback Changes[/h1]

	[h1]Important Notice - Linux Users[/h1]
		[b]We've changed a configuration on Steam that should enable users to use Steam functionalities. Please let us know if achievements and cloud saving are working![/b]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where Rockstone Mountain was loopable.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the entire Judgement floor would be filled with gold.
		[*]Fixed the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/1499000547471037889/?ctp=2#c1499000547483864331]bug reported[/url] by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/fishbaitism]Banana Crayons[/url] 
		[*]Fixed a rare bug where the game could crash when changing difficulties.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the game would start in a full, blackscreen if not using compatibility mode. [b]Note:[/b] from our testings, the issue seems fixed. If you experienced this in the past, please let us know if you still experience it or not.
		[*]Fixed a bug where gold coins would not be displayed during local co-op.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the second player could not allocate stat points during local co-op. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198024404071]Anakya[/url] for reporting this and many more issues related with local co-op!
		[*][b](Suggestion Implementation)[/b]Changed bloodletting sword to deplete 9 hp every second (from 3 hp). Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198018615064]fewRy[/url] for the feedback!
		[*][b](Suggestion Implementation)[/b]Changed traps so they now deal a percentage of health as damage, instead of flat damage, with minimum damage cap. The higher the difficulty, the higher the percentage of health taken.
		[*]Normalized trap damage amount and types (i.e.: boulders no longer deal magic damage, instead deal physical damage, etc.).
	[/list]]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

		[*]In some systems (both operative system and hardware components), the game has severe lags spikes for brief periods of time. This usually has to do with malfunctioning input devices, but a fix is being developed. If this occurs to you, please send an email to laminastudios@gmail.com with the operative system you have and hardware, as well as any relevant information (the time you were playing at and what were you doing).
		[*]Currently, to some players, Steam functionalities are not working under Linux systems, as well as a few in-game functionalities (such as minimap). We are working into resolving this issue.
		[*]During co-op, heroes have a different currency than the one specified on the HUD, resulting in some characters being able to buy certain items that the other player can't (due to gold spent). This will be fixed in a future patch.
	[/list]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where Rockstone Mountain was loopable.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the entire Judgement floor would be filled with gold.
		[*]Fixed the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/1499000547471037889/?ctp=2#c1499000547483864331]bug reported[/url] by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/fishbaitism]Banana Crayons[/url] 
		[*]Fixed a rare bug where the game could crash when changing difficulties.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the game would start in a full, blackscreen if not using compatibility mode. [b]Note:[/b] from our testings, the issue seems fixed. If you experienced this in the past, please let us know if you still experience it or not.
		[*]Fixed a bug where gold coins would not be displayed during local co-op.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the second player could not allocate stat points during local co-op. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198024404071]Anakya[/url] for reporting this and many more issues related with local co-op!
		[*][b](Suggestion Implementation)[/b]Changed bloodletting sword to deplete 9 hp every second (from 3 hp). Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198018615064]fewRy[/url] for the feedback!
		[*][b](Suggestion Implementation)[/b]Changed traps so they now deal a percentage of health as damage, instead of flat damage, with minimum damage cap. The higher the difficulty, the higher the percentage of health taken.
		[*]Normalized trap damage amount and types (i.e.: boulders no longer deal magic damage, instead deal physical damage, etc.).
	[/list]]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	[list]
		[*]In some systems (both operative system and hardware components), the game has severe lags spikes for brief periods of time. This usually has to do with malfunctioning input devices, but a fix is being developed. If this occurs to you, please send an email to laminastudios@gmail.com with the operative system you have and hardware, as well as any relevant information (the time you were playing at and what were you doing).
		[*]Currently, to some players, Steam functionalities are not working under Linux systems, as well as a few in-game functionalities (such as minimap). We are working into resolving this issue.
		[*]During co-op, heroes have a different currency than the one specified on the HUD, resulting in some characters being able to buy certain items that the other player can't (due to gold spent). This will be fixed in a future patch.
	[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.0.5.2
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lg1r8XF.png[/img]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This patch brings some fixes and feedback changes.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
		
	[h1]GUI[/h1]
		[u]Ability Level Up[/u]
			Changed the level up overlay of abilities so that cooldown is no longer blocked. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the feedback!
		
		[u]Gamepad Deadzone Axis[/u]
			We've added a new option under "Gamepad Settings" that enables the player to customize the global deadzone value for the joysticks of gamepads. The higher the value, the higher the displacement of the joystick needs to be for the game to recognize that the joystick has moved.
	
	[h1]Arcane Forge[/h1]
		[u]Armory[/u]
			You can now unequip items. To do so, press 'R' (or the Y button on a gamepad) to enter in the unequip mode. Pressing the "pick" key will remove the selected item.
			
	[h1]Items[/h1]
		[u]Power Weapons[/u]
			Changed conversion effect of all power weapons. Now converts 5% of the damage dealt, instead of 100%.
	
[h1]Bug Fixes & Feedback Changes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where Angry Clouds would leave graphical clutter after death.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the description of items in the shop could overlay when having a flavour text value of "all".
		[*]Fixed a bug where Rockstone Mountain could be repeated indefinitely due to "Strange Rock" spawning after visiting the hidden area.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the walls on "The End" would miss texture on certain parts.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the Core's health would still be drawn even after reaching 0HP.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the arcane forge's forged text could appear in other menus.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the fairy from neophyte ranks would disappear after the first floor.
		[*]Fixed a glitch where the information messages (such as the pet info) would have weird text placement.
		[*]Fixed an exploit where chests would spawn after quickloading.
		[*]Fixed a bug where difficulty settings were not being synched properly.
		[*]Fixed a bug where gamepads and controllers could bypass difficulty unlocks.
		[*]Fixed a bug where gamepads would still be found even when "Disable gamepad" was on.
		[*]Fixed a bug where gamepad deadzone would not be recognized for the right stick (we're still going to implement the way to customize the deadzone value).
		[*]Fixed a bug where Chroma Sword recipe was not being granted correctly. [b]Everyone who got all recipes from Chroma event, except the Chroma Sword, will receive the Chroma Sword automatically[/b]
		[*]Fixed a bug where Mac users would not get the game to go window mode with the correct window resolution, when in windowed mode.
		[*]Improved FPS when casting Archer's Rain of Arrows.
		[*]Changed the walls on Rockstone Mountain to contrast better with the floor.
		[*]Applied an overlay effect to marks on Rockstone Mountain so they could be better distinguished from the floor.
		[*]Made the item information on the inventory screen more opaque with the goal of providing clearer information.
		[*]Changed teleporters so that they only stop working if items are near it, not potions.
	[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	[list]
		[*]In some systems (both operative system and hardware components), the game has severe lags spikes for brief periods of time. This usually has to do with malfunctioning input devices, but a fix is being developed. If this occurs to you, please send an email to laminastudios@gmail.com with the operative system you have and hardware, as well as any relevant information (the time you were playing at and what were you doing).
		[*]Currently, Steam functionalities are not working under Linux systems, as well as a few in-game functionalities (such as minimap). We are working into resolving this issue.
	[/list]

notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xq9wLEJ.jpg?1[/img]
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	This patch brings permanent content for the game.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	[h1]Areas[/h1]
		[h1]([u]NEW[/u])Core[/h1]
			
[spoiler]The Core is a new secret map where the Dungeon Souls' core resides. The teleporter to access this level has a chance of appearing at the last dungeon of the game (The End). Its appearance is caused by an instability	on the Core. Enemies in this map are specially hard and the boss can only be beaten by picking up Stabilizing Agents. Despite this, the rewards are epic - a new set of [b]extremely[/b] powerful weapons.[/spoiler]

Be careful though - this map is especially hard!
			
		[b]Access:[/b]
			[spoiler]
				On "The End", a teleporter has a chance of spawning.
			[/spoiler]
			
		[b]Boss Battle:[/b]
			[spoiler]
				The player has to beat enemies that are spawned by the Core until a Stabilizing Agent is dropped. When picked up, it will damage the Core.
			[/spoiler]
			
		[b]Rewards:[/b]
			Power Weapon recipes (these recipes can only be picked on this area)
			
		[h1]([u]NEW[/u]) Rockstone Mountain[/h1]
			[spoiler]
			Rockstone Mountain is a new secret map, taking the player to a very high place! Even though the area is filled with dangerous enemies, there is no boss at sight. However, there is a rather peculiar object on the boss' level instead...
			[/spoiler]
			Be careful though - this map is hard!
			
		[b]Access:[/b]
			[spoiler]
				The Strange Rock is the key to teleport the player. It spawns on The Judgement's Level. The player must hold one of the following items: Compass, Magnet, Spiked Shoes, Butterfly Wings
			[/spoiler]
			
		[b]Boss Battle:[/b]
			[spoiler]
				There is no boss battle at this stage. Instead, there is a rather peculiar statue.
				
				[spoiler]
					Triggering the statue causes a small instability on the Dungeon's Core.
					
					[spoiler]
						The instability increases the chances of the Core's teleporter to spawn on the End level.
					[/spoiler]
				[/spoiler]
			[/spoiler]
			
		[b]Rewards:[/b]

		The game now has Pets! Pets are creatures that are picked up like items and will follow the owner. Their stats are mostly based off the owner's stats and they can attack nearby enemies and even pick up nearby loot! They are also invinsible and follow you around.
		
		
	[h1]Events[/h1]

			Everyone who completed the valentine event's challenge this year will get all the recipes for the items obtainable during the event! The unique ingredients will also be supplied.
	
		[h1]([u]NEW[/u]) Halloween[/h1]
			The halloween event has just arrived! From the 26th of october to the 2nd of november, you will be able to play the special game mode in "Forsaken Tomb"! In this mode, you'll have to defend the Pumpkin Spirit by fighting 10 waves of enemies. If you reach the end, special Halloween loot will be provided!
			
		[b]Objective:[/b]
			Fight all 10 waves without letting the Pumpkin Spirit die.

			A Pumpkin Chest filled with special Halloween ingredients, as well as legendary Halloween recipes!

notes.title: DUNGEON SOULS v1.0.4 - CRASH ERROR MESSAGE HOTFIX
notes.content:
Hi [b]everyone[/b] thank you for bearing with us as we tried to investigate on the issue that you have recently encountered.

[h1]REMINDERS[/h1]

Steam Cloud Sync must be [b]ENABLED[/b].

[u]For Windows Users[/u]:

Check directory: C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\DungeonSouls

Look for the following files and make sure it's in the [b]DungeonSouls[/b] folder:

[list]
   [*] Configuration.ini (This is important to be in the DungeonSouls folder)
   [*] Save.ini
[/list]

If you encountered a crash error message, please uninstall and re-install the game. Then follow IMPORTANT - C.

[h1]WHERE Configuration.ini and/or Save.ini SHOULD BE SAVED[/h1]

Directory: C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\DungeonSouls


[u]What if AppData is hidden?[/u]

1. Go to C:\Users\username\
2. In Windows Explorer, select "View" Tab (File, Home, Share, View)
3. Click on "Options" (right-most of the panel)
4. Select "Change folder and search options"
5. Under "Folder Options," click on "View" Tab
6. Under "Files and Folders," check radio button "Show hidden files, folders, and drives."
7. Then hit "Apply" button and "Ok" button

notes.title: DUNGEON SOULS v1.0.4 - BUG FIXES
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mQI3MrS.png[/img]

[h1]SCOPE[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This maintenance patch fixes several bugs found and reported by players on the 21/09/2017.
	
	
[h1]BUG FIXES & CHANGES[/h1]

	[u]Details of this section[/u]:

	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	[list]
		[*]Going into "Options" in the main menu will no longer cause the game to restart.
		[*]Potentially fixed a bug where players could not disable the gamepad (has yet to be confirmed by the majority of players).
		[*]Fixed a button where the Passive's button for the gamepad in the character select screen was not working properly.
		[*]Added a new options section called "Gamepad Settings" where you can enable and disable the gamepad's aim bot.
		[*]Fixed a bug where Mac users could not get past a question box, due to interal engine issues, when recovering backup data.
		[*]Fixed a bug where items that would spawn physical objects (like Bleeding Eyeball and Spike Ball) would disappear after quickload.
		[*]Fixed a bug where multiple 'Eh!'s would appear.
	[/list]
	
[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]

	[list]
		[*]Game won't work on windows 10 unless it has compatibility mode enabled (we are working to have both versions supported).
		[*]Some players seem to be unable to disable the gamepad. We are working with players to fix this issue.
	[/list]
	
[h1]SPECIAL THANKS[/h1]

	A big special thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198127911704]brontolo2001[/url] for helping find bugs with the game!

notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.0.4 - HOTFIX
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bpN8krU.png[/img]

[h1]SCOPE[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This maintenance patch fixes several bugs found and reported by players.
	
[h1]GAMEPAD SUPPORT[/h1]
	
	[h1](BETA) Optimization & AI[/h1]
		Several reviews have pointed out that the controller scheme, no matter what it was, would feel a bit uncomfortable at playing, rendering the option useless. As such, we created an aimbot system with the following functionalities:
		[list]
			[*][b]Auto Aim Assist[/b]: The AI will automatically target nearby enemies, if the player is not using the controller's aim stick.
			[*][b]Auto Direction[/b]: The AI will automatically target a position slightly in front of the character's direction. This function has the objective to minimize the aim-stick movement for casual interactions.
		[/list]
		
		Please let us know if we should keep this feature in and/or improve it!
	
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where soul orbs would act weirdly and possibly crash the game.
		[*]Fixed an optimization bug where invisible walls would spawn and stop the player from completing a level.
		[*]Fixed several graphical issues.
		[*]Increase FPS count, on average, by 20 FPS.
		[*]Fixed a bug where certain quicksave stats were not being kept.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the compass would stop working after a quickload.
		[*]Quicksave no longer closes the game. Instead, brings the player to the main menu.
		[*]Fixed a major bug in local-coop where Xbox controllers or other gamepads would not work as intended.
		[*]Fixed a bug where Xbox controllers or other gamepads would show an odd behaviour in single player.
		[*]Fixed a bug in local coop that would display the incorrect graphical assets on character select.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the game would crash if the map frame was enabled.
		[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the game to crash after several restarts.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the brawler and engineer would not get reset when attempting to "Reset Data".
		[*]Changed the "Reset Data" so that the story-made actions are also reset.
	[/list]

[h1]SPECIAL THANKS[/h1]

	A big special thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198127911704]brontolo2001[/url] for helping find bugs with the game!

[h1]DEVELOPER NOTE[/h1]

	We'd like to talk with you about the last few months of progression in Dungeon Souls. As you may have noticed, there weren't any significant updates in the past months and the game looked a bit "neglected" or even discontinued. We do apologize for this kind of feeling we let off. Despite the fact that content wise the progress was slow, we've been doing several analysis of the community's reviews and taking time to fix the bugs and issues with the game. We've also taken time to re-structure our QA process so that you don't have to suffer with so many bugs (since it really doesn't seem professional and I believe we can all agree on that). We do want you to know that we do care a lot about your reviews of the game and we read and evaluate every single one. We'd also like to thank those of you that were understanding of the situation.
	
	Apart from the above, we can promise that we have quite a lot of content updates planned until the end of the year, already on the making! 

[h1]MOST RECENT FIXES[/h1]

We have fixed the following issues found in the last 24h:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Nightblade could get negative armour
[*]Fixed a bug where Linux would start in fullscreen, but the game would be stuck on the bottom left corner with a small screen size.
[*]Fixed a bug where passive bonus weren't being correctly applied.
[*]Fixed a bug where changing options and starting the game could crash for some users.
[/list]

[h1]REMINDER[/h1]

Please check if the game now works for you. If not, please head over to the bugs and issues in the forum. Let us know what's going on and what can we do to replicate your problem.

notes.title: Minor Patch for Dungeon Souls v1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/i8LJMsQ.png[/img]
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This is a minor patch to fix some of the bugs found in 1.0.4, adding two new game-quality features.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
		
	[u]Crash Manager[/u]
		Added a new mechanism that detects when a crash occurs during a playthrough. If such an event happens, the manager will recover the amount of gold collected, as well as the rank.
		
	[u]Quicksave[/u]
		Added a new quicksave feature to the game. Every time you defeat a boss, a Gate appears. This gate allows you to quicksave your run, just in case you want to take a break from playing but keep going with the run!
	
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
		
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where Razer effects were not being displayed properly.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the game would crash at start under certain conditions.
		[*]Fixed minor bugs.
		[*][b]Aware:[/b] There are still some people experiencing a black screen. We are looking into this issue.
		[*][b]Aware:[/b] Sometimes, the player can go out-of-bounds. We are looking into a mechanism that fixes this issue.
		[*][b]Aware:[/b] Sometimes, the Soul Orb does not spawn. We are trying to reproduce this issue and fix it.
	[/list]

[h1]Coming Next[/h1]

Here are a few things that are coming next patch:

[*][b]Controller optimization[/b] - We're adding an aimbot that will help controller players making the game easier to play by reducing awkwardness related with aiming.
[*][b]Event-Related Items[/b]
[*][b]Events[/b]
[*][b]New Zones[/b]
[*][b]Secret Mechanic[/b]

	This is a minor patch to fix some of the bugs found in 1.0.4, adding two new game-quality features.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
		
	[u]Crash Manager[/u]
		Added a new mechanism that detects when a crash occurs during a playthrough. If such an event happens, the manager will recover the amount of gold collected, as well as the rank.
		
	[u]Quicksave[/u]
		Added a new quicksave feature to the game. Every time you defeat a boss, a Gate appears. This gate allows you to quicksave your run, just in case you want to take a break from playing but keep going with the run!

	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

		[*]Fixed a bug where the game would crash at start under certain conditions.
		[*]Fixed minor bugs.
		[*][b]Aware:[/b] There are still some people experiencing a black screen. We are looking into this issue.
		[*][b]Aware:[/b] Sometimes, the player can go out-of-bounds. We are looking into a mechanism that fixes this issue.
		[*][b]Aware:[/b] Sometimes, the Soul Orb does not spawn. We are trying to reproduce this issue and fix it.
	[/list]

[h1]Coming Next[/h1]

Here are a few things that are coming next patch:

[*][b]Controller optimization[/b] - We're adding an aimbot that will help controller players making the game easier to play by reducing awkwardness related with aiming.

[*][b]Events[/b]
[*][b]New Zones[/b]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update v1.0.4 - UI/UX Redesign and Razer Chroma
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CwG5afB.png[/img]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This patch brings a re-newed user interface, as well as compatibility with Razer Chroma devices.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
		
	[u]UI Remake[/u]
		The game's user interface has undergone several changes to make it easier for new players, whilst making it familiar to old players. We tried to balance both of these factors whilst doing it!
		Here follows a list of UI elements changed:
		
		[b]Gameplay[/b]
		[list]
			[*]Added new flavour text options to disable most of the text clutter during gameplay for experienced players.
			[*]Traded most some of the game's text-based information for icon-based information.
			[*]Fixed a visual bug with the inventory menu
			[*]Changed visual representation of skill points in the stats menu.
		[/list]
		
		[b]Gamepad Aware[/b]
		[list]
			[*]The game will now change and display information from several UI elements if a gamepad is detected.
		[/list]
		
		[b]Controller's Skill Menu[/b]
		[list]
			[*]Changed the active selector of skills
			[*]Made the menu compatible with other menus (so it wouldn't overlay)
			[*]Changed the position of elements around to occupy a smaller space.
		[/list]
		
		[b]Character Select[/b]
		[list]
			[*]Changed the titles of the classes to have a unique feel to each hero.
			[*]Changed the position of the passive button to a more noticable place.
			[*]Added new smoke particle effects
			[*]The menu now shows what weapon the hero has currently equipped.
			[*]Added tooltips for gamepad.
			[*]Changed the passive's menu to be compatible with the gamepad.
		[/list]
		
		[b]Armory Menu[/b]
		[list]
			[*]The inventory now has an active selector.
			[*]Changed the heroes' titles.
			[*]Changed the color theme of the description for a more friendly gradient to the eye.
		[/list]
		
		[b]Crafting Menu[/b]
		[list]
			[*]Fixed a bug where the arcane forge could have elements outside of the game's window in certain resolutions
			[*]Re-vamped particle effects
			[*]Added an active selector for each type of menu
			[*]Traded text elements for icon-elements
			[*]Changed the heroes' titles
		[/list]
	
	[u]Hardware Compatibility[/u]
		[b]Razer Chroma[/b]
			Added support for Razer Chroma devices! Here follows a list of the devices that are supported by Dungeon Souls:
			[list]
				[*]Keyboard
				[*]MousePad
				[*]Mouse
				[*]Headset
			[/list]
			
	[u]Tutorial[/u]
		Added two new stages to the tutorial to explain how to progress through the level, as well as what materials are and can be used for.
	
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	[list]
		[*]Increased the game's FPS count by a slight amount.
		[*]Fixed minor bugs in the game.
	[/list]
[h1]For Assistance/Support, e-mail us: [b]support@laminastudios.com[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls v1.0.2 - Love Temple
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FQUo9ki.jpg[/img]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	This patch version fixes a few bugs with steam related services, as well as some exploits of the game.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	
	[h1]Events[/h1]
		[h1]([u]NEW[/u]) Valentine's[/h1]
			A new stage was added to celebrate valentine's day! Help the cupids of the [b]Love Temple[/b] get
		rid of the stone cold Gargoyles!
		
		[b]Objective:[/b]
			Save as many cupids as possible. The cupids spawn alongsided with the gargoyles whenever you touch a mark. The gargoyles are strong, so be prepared to take them down quickly!
		
		[b]Reward:[/b]
			For each cupid saved, there will be an uncommon item waiting for you at the door. There's a high chance of one of those items being a rare item!
		
		[b]Accessibility:[/b]
			You can access the [b]Love Temple[/b] via the [b]pink teleporter[/b]. The pink teleporter has a chance of appearing near the portal in the [b]Cathedral[/b] area. It will not spawn in a boss room.
			
		[b]Duration:[/b]
			The event lasts from 14th of February to the 20th of February!
	
	[h1]Story[/h1]
	[list]
		[*]Added new story elements to the game!
		[*][b]([u]NEW[/u])Final Cutscenes:[/b] added a final ending cutscene for each possible ending.
		[*]Updated soundtrack of the game.
	[/list]
	
	[h1]Judgement[/h1]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Death Animation: [/b]Added an unskipable cutscene when the first phase of the Judgement ends. The cutscene shows the summoning of the second phase.
	
	Added a beam of light whenever a boss is summoned to aid judgement.
	
	[h1]GUI[/h1]
		Changed the update behaviour of the hero GUI's health bar. The bar now refreshes faster when the player loses hp, proportional to the amount of health lost.
	
	[h1]Life Steal[/h1]
		Now only applies to damage dealt by a hero. Still heals all heroes.
	
	[h1]Optimization[/h1]
		Decreased the base amount of memory (RAM) usage from 580-600MB to 250-300MB, at a cost of a bit more of the cpu. However, the cpu used should be very spontaneous.
		Decreased the size of the game file to around 90MB.

	
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	
	[list]
		[*]Lifesteal pop up now shows "stolen" instead of "syphoned" and now displays the amount of health recovered.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the game could crash due to a surface rendering problem.
		[*]Fixed a bug where you could exploit the game and bypass levels
		[*]Fixed a bug where the Skeleton King would cut the audio at "The End" level.
		[*]Fixed a bug with Glass Cannon where you could exploit the stat increase of characters such as the Destroyer and get infinite damage.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the game would crash upon defeating the Soul Guardian if certain requirements were met for the Soul Orb.
		[*]Fixed the Golden Shelf's range to match the tooltip range.
		[*]Fixed a bug where a memory leak would occur in the game, causing an "Out of Memory!" fatal error to appear.
		[*]Fixed a bug where cloud saving wasn't working properly.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the Skeleton King achievement was being given without the requirements being met.
		[*]Baker Achievement now no longer needs story-only recipes to be completed. This means recipes like "Murderer Ring" are not needed to get the achivement.
		[*]Fixed a bug where allied units (such as the necromancer's skeletons and the engineer's spiders) were not being damaged.
	[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Launch Hotfix (Update #16.1)
notes.content:
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Hotfix for patch 16.
		
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	
	[list]
		[*]Fixed a bug where using the cleric's gate, wizard's clone and necro's skeletons would cause the game to crash unexpectedly.
		[*]Fixed a bug where enemies would cause the game to crash under certain conditions.
		[*]Fixed a bug where pausing the game and resuming could sometimes crash the game.
		[*]Fixed a bug where using a 360 controller could cause the main menu to crash the game.
		[*]Fixed a bug where the character select screen could crash if the game was on second plane for a prolonged period of time.

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Launch (Update #16)
notes.content:
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 16 introduces Local Co-op, as well as minor balance changes, graphical updates and story implementation. Steam cards and achievements are now enabled. The patch also adds a few bug fixes along the way.
	
	The minor balance attempts to make the experience of playing melee heroes a bit easier, by increasing their base health.
	
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

	
	[h1]Heroes[/h1]
	
	[h1]Balance[/h1]
		[b]Melee Heroes[/b]:
			-Increased base health by 20. This initial health boost, alongsided with the passives, should make melee heroes easier to play (allowing one or two more hits in each level).
		
	[h1]Credits[/h1]
		-Updated credits to reflect the new 
		
	[h1][u](NEW) [/u]Local Co-op[/h1]
		
		Dungeon Souls can now be played with up to two players, on a local computer!
		
		[h1]Rules:[/h1]
		
			On the Local Co-op game mode, there are several rules that are applied to the standard way of playing the game. They are as follows:
			[list]
				[*]The local co-op only supports 2 players playing at the same time. Player 1 must use the keyboard. Player 2 can attach any gamepad to play.
				[*]Every enemy's stats are increased by 1.75x their original value. This multiplier is applied after the difficulty multiplier. This makes the game remain challenging, even in local co-op.
				[*]Players have shared inventory. This means that items picked by one player will also benefit the other player's stats.
				[*]Players have shared passives. This means the passives upgraded on the single player run will also affect the local co-op run.
				[*]The screen is split in half and each player has their own screen to play. This means that there are two cursors for each screen. The cursor's color will depend on the player's hero color.
				[*]If one player dies, their screen will turn black and display the "Dead" message. If, however, the other player can reach a boss stage, all players get revived.
				[*]Arcane Forge appear beside Player 1.
				[*]The game's story elements will only have in account Player 1.
				[*]Only one stats upgrade menu can be opened at a time.
				[*]Only one inventory menu can be opened at a time.
			[/list]
			
			These rules will be available in-game on an upcoming patch.

	[h1]Art Assets[/h1]
	
		[h1]The End[/h1]
			
			All art assets of "The End" dungeon have been updated to match the game's current look-and-feel.
	
	[h1]Gameplay Mechanics[/h1]
	
		[h1]The End[/h1]
		
			[b][u](REMOVED)[/u]Auto-Teleport[/b]
				Killing all enemies in "The End" will no longer cause a 3 second timer to teleport you to the center of the room.
			
			[b][u](NEW)[/u]Obelisk Teleporter[/b]
				After defeating every enemy on each stage, an obelisk will appear beside the player. This obelisk allows the player to teleport to the room's portal.
			
		[h1]Story Elements[/h1]
		[spoiler]
			[b][u](NEW)[/u]Soul Orb Collection[/b]
			
				Heroes can now collect their respective Soul Orbs from the Soul Guardian. Each player has its own Soul Orb (indicated by the pulsating color of the hero, as well as displayed on the item's tooltip). If the hero manages to defeat Selene with a Soul Orb, the Soul Orb's hero will get resurrected. Each hero can only collect up to 3 Soul Orbs per game.
				
				This mechanic is the way of beating the game. End-game scenes will be available on an upcoming patch!
		[/spoiler]
		
	[h1]Steam Cards and Achievements[/h1]
	
		Steam Cards, Badges and Achievements have been added! There are 10 available achievements to collect (although, in this patch, only 9 can be unlocked).
			
[h1]Items[/h1]
	
	No changes to state.
	
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

	[b]Selene[/b]
	
		[list]
		[*]Added two more attack patterns to spice up the battle
		[*]Added more torches to the boss battle room to make it easier to spot attacks.
		[*]Reduced base health from 15 000 health to 10 000 health.
		[*]Updated art assets.
		[/list]

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

-[h1]Arcane Forge[/h1] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	No changes to state.
		
		
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	
	[list]
		[*][b]Can You Shush For A Second? -[/b] Fixed a bug where boss voice lines could repeat indefinitely. Now, each boss voice line has the minimum duration of 1 second. This means that another voice line can only be played once the previous voice line has played for 1 second.
		[*][b]No More Nausea Please![/b] - Fixed a bug where moving the cursor whilst viewing the player's inventory would cause the background to move. This contrast in static-movement could cause nauseous effects.
		[*]Fixed a bug where Gamepad Reticule Aid could create undesired behaviour. The system was changed to behave more passively and only if it detects the player needs aid with aiming.
		[*]Heavily increased FPS to account for Local Co-op. [b]NOTE:[/b] The FPS increase between each patch should now reach a halt, as most of the optimization has been completed. If you still have trouble running the game, please refer to the Contact Information on the game's Credits for further assistance.
	[/list]
	

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	Here follows a list of all the known issues and/or suggestions that we've taken a look into but were unable to fix for this patch. Hopefully, this list gets shorter with each patch :)

	
	[b]Known Issues[/b]
	-Due to the way the engineer behaves, his spider are dealing more damage than anticipated (each spider is dealing the displayed tooltip damage). We'll try to balance this issue out.
	-Some dungeons can spawn without any marks. We have special plans for this situation ;)
	-A new mechanic to cap the movement speed of heroes is needed, due to some of them still going sonic-like when using certain movement speed objects.
	
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Multiplayer functionality. This feature is an end-development feature but we intend to make it happen!
	
	-A page on the main menu that allows you to view all the items you obtained during previous runs, as well as their descriptions. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #15.2
notes.content:
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 15.2 introduces several bug fixes. It also introduces a revamped passive system, as well as some minor refinements to the User Interface.
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	
	[h1]Passives[/h1]
	
	[b]Revamped[/b]
	
		The passives mechanism has been changed. Previously, the passives bonuses would only apply at the starting stats of the hero. Here follow the changes:
			-When the maximum health, attack damage, magical damage, magical resist or defense stats increase, the passive bonus is also applied.
			-Speed passive will only be based off of the hero's initial speed.
			-Critical effect adds to the hero's critical effect.
			-Hp regen is now based off of a flat amount, instead of the player's percentage health.
			-[b][u](CHANGED)[/u]Greed[/b] now increases all gold gained by 4% per level, up to a total of 40% increase.
			
			Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Dynatriel]Dynatriel[/url] for the suggestion!
			
	[h1]User Interface[/h1]
		-Changed the "Press [Tab]" key text to "[Tab] to assign stats".
		-The stats level up text indicator now blinks to call the player's attention.
		-The skill-up icons now glow to call the player's attention.
		-The walls on the mini-map are now represented by solid-white blocks instead of wireframe squares.
		-The hero emits small particles when holding an Angel Feather.
		
		[h3]Flavour Text[/h3]
		-Added flavour text option for Speed Up
		-Added flavour text option for Experience
		-Added flavour text for damage dealt to enemies
	
	[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
		[b][u](NEW)[/u]Gamepad Reticule Aid:[/b] when using a gamepad, the aiming reticule will go along with the player's movement when the right stick is on rest. This should make it easier to attack incoming enemies.
		Thanks to a Steam user who suggested this idea! Unfortunately, we haven't been able to find your account, but you shall not be unrecognized!
		
[h1]Items[/h1]

	We've added a story-sensitive item, hence the spoiler!
	
	[spoiler]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Murderer's Ring[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Adds +10 to physical damage, magic damage, magic resist and defense. Every 5 seconds, spawns lasers to damage nearby enemies.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Equipable (Evil)
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Dynatriel]Dynatriel[/url] for suggesting that the players who kill the owl should also be rewarded (evily)!
	[/spoiler]
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

	[b]NOTE:[/b] We know we haven't been implementing any new enemies, but we are keeping a close look at the suggestions! We're going to implement a few in the future, so don't worry if you think your suggestion isn't being read - we can assure you it is!

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Arcane Forge[/h1] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	We've added story-sensitive ingredients, hence the spoiler!
	
	[h1]Ingredients[/h1]
	
	[spoiler]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Wizard Remenant[/b] - Used to craft Murderer's Ring.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Owl Remenants[/b] - Used to craft Murderer's Ring.
	[/spoiler]
	
	[h1]Recipes[/h1]
	
	[spoiler]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Murderer's Ring Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Evil.
	[/spoiler]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
		
	-Fixed a bug where Selene would stop attacking if the player stood at a great distance.
	-Fixed a bug where Angel Feather would not get picked up, failing to revive the player.
	-Fixed a bug where Arcane Forge ingredients were not getting consumed if their stack count was 1.
	-Fixed a bug where you could use activable items during cutscenes.
	-Fixed a bug where Skeleton King would sometimes cause the game to crash.
	-Fixed a bug where disabling the critical flavour text would not really disable it.
	-Fixed a bug where pressing the Q key would cause the game to take a screenshot and make it lag. This key is now configurable in the controls menu.
	-Fixed a bug where Vital Armour would not heal you.
	-Fixed a bug where Selene's Knives could cause the game to crash under certain conditions.
	-Increased FPS by a small amount.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	Here follows a list of all the known issues and/or suggestions that we've taken a look into but were unable to fix for this patch. Hopefully, this list gets shorter with each patch :)

	[b]Known Issues[/b]
	-Due to the way the engineer behaves, his spider are dealing more damage than anticipated (each spider is dealing the displayed tooltip damage). We'll try to balance this issue out.
	-Some dungeons can spawn without any marks. We have special plans for this situation ;)
	-A new mechanic to cap the movement speed of heroes is needed, due to some of them still going sonic-like when using certain movement speed objects.
	-The game has performance issues on some areas.
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Coming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Multiplayer functionality. This feature is an end-development feature but we intend to make it happen!
	
	-A page on the main menu that allows you to view all the items you obtained during previous runs, as well as their descriptions. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!
