		-The skill-up icons now glow to call the player's attention.
		-The walls on the mini-map are now represented by solid-white blocks instead of wireframe squares.
		-The hero emits small particles when holding an Angel Feather.
		
		[h3]Flavour Text[/h3]
		-Added flavour text option for Speed Up
		-Added flavour text option for Experience
		-Added flavour text for damage dealt to enemies
	
	[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
		[b][u](NEW)[/u]Gamepad Reticule Aid:[/b] when using a gamepad, the aiming reticule will go along with the player's movement when the right stick is on rest. This should make it easier to attack incoming enemies.
		Thanks to a Steam user who suggested this idea! Unfortunately, we haven't been able to find your account, but you shall not be unrecognized!
		
[h1]Items[/h1]

	We've added a story-sensitive item, hence the spoiler!
	
	[spoiler]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Murderer's Ring[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Adds +10 to physical damage, magic damage, magic resist and defense. Every 5 seconds, spawns lasers to damage nearby enemies.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Equipable (Evil)
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Dynatriel]Dynatriel[/url] for suggesting that the players who kill the owl should also be rewarded (evily)!
	[/spoiler]
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

	[b]NOTE:[/b] We know we haven't been implementing any new enemies, but we are keeping a close look at the suggestions! We're going to implement a few in the future, so don't worry if you think your suggestion isn't being read - we can assure you it is!

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Arcane Forge[/h1] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	We've added story-sensitive ingredients, hence the spoiler!
	
	[h1]Ingredients[/h1]
	
	[spoiler]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Wizard Remenant[/b] - Used to craft Murderer's Ring.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Owl Remenants[/b] - Used to craft Murderer's Ring.
	[/spoiler]
	
	[h1]Recipes[/h1]
	
	[spoiler]
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Murderer's Ring Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Evil.
	[/spoiler]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
		
	-Fixed a bug where Selene would stop attacking if the player stood at a great distance.
	-Fixed a bug where Angel Feather would not get picked up, failing to revive the player.
	-Fixed a bug where Arcane Forge ingredients were not getting consumed if their stack count was 1.
	-Fixed a bug where you could use activable items during cutscenes.
	-Fixed a bug where Skeleton King would sometimes cause the game to crash.
	-Fixed a bug where disabling the critical flavour text would not really disable it.
	-Fixed a bug where pressing the Q key would cause the game to take a screenshot and make it lag. This key is now configurable in the controls menu.
	-Fixed a bug where Vital Armour would not heal you.
	-Fixed a bug where Selene's Knives could cause the game to crash under certain conditions.
	-Increased FPS by a small amount.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	Here follows a list of all the known issues and/or suggestions that we've taken a look into but were unable to fix for this patch. Hopefully, this list gets shorter with each patch :)

	[b]Known Issues[/b]
	-Due to the way the engineer behaves, his spider are dealing more damage than anticipated (each spider is dealing the displayed tooltip damage). We'll try to balance this issue out.
	-Some dungeons can spawn without any marks. We have special plans for this situation ;)
	-A new mechanic to cap the movement speed of heroes is needed, due to some of them still going sonic-like when using certain movement speed objects.
	-The game has performance issues on some areas.
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Coming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Multiplayer functionality. This feature is an end-development feature but we intend to make it happen!
	
	-A page on the main menu that allows you to view all the items you obtained during previous runs, as well as their descriptions. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #15
notes.content:
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 15 introduces the final boss area where the player will fight with Selene. We've also tweaked arcane forge's user interface and added new features to it.
	
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

	[b](NEW)[/b] Life steal mechanism has changed. It now displays a text informing how much the player has healed with the enemy's damage. Also, life steal will benefit from ALL damage dealt to an enemy,
	whether it was from the player or not. 
	
	[h1]Areas[/h1]
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])The End[/b]
		A new area has been added! "The End" is the game's final area and the area where you get to fight Selene, the Dungeon Master. This area is currently a Work In Progress (W.I.P.) and as such, it may have a few bugs
		and missing art assets. However, it should be playable and enjoyable too! It is still missing final cutscenes, but those will come later ːsteamhappyː
		
		Unlike other areas, this area does not randomly generate itself. It is a final challenge for the player and will always have the same shape and monsters in it.
		
	[h1]UI[/h1]
	
		We've changed the way currency is drawn in the game. Every currency drawn will now have marks seperating each three pairs of digits. For example, the number 123456 will be drawn as 123.456

[h1]Items[/h1]
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Bloodletting Sword[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Constantly drains 3 hp every second, but gives 100% life steal.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198045937188]TBYK101[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Redprint[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Traps deal higher damage and can damage enemies.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/J0SHSPAGE]Drybones08[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Glass Cannon[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] All defense stats (defense and bonus defense) are converted into physical damage. All resists stats (magic resists and bonus magic resist) are converted into magical damage. Any stats gained from other items will also be converted.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/the_moist_man]The Long Hard Dick Of The Law[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Pet Potato[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Increases gold and experience gained by 10%.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198117584185]Speggi[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ninby's Grace[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Provides the player with a shield whose strength is equal to 10% of the player's maximum health. This shield regenerates every 10 seconds.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Equipable
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user Ninby for their participation on the forums and the game. This is our way of thanking you! (and we're sorry we couldn't find your steam profile)
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Herberk's Pendant[/b]

	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Has a 50% chance of redirecting incoming enemy projectiles. This effect occurs every second.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Equipable
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herberk[/url] for their participation on the forums and the game, specially with the suggestion of arcane forge. This is our way of thanking you!
	
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]


	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Shadow ???[/b]
	
	- A new enemy approaches with the identity of a known nemesis.
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Selene[/b]
	
	-The dungeon master awaits you.

	[b]NOTE:[/b] We know we haven't been implementing any new enemies, but we are keeping a close look at the suggestions! We're going to implement a few in the future, so don't worry if you think your suggestion isn't being read - we can assure you it is!

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Arcane Forge[/h1] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])UI Re-vamp[/b]

	We've changed the arcane forge's User Interface and made it a bit more intuitive. It now has two sections: armory and crafting. Please tell us if you like this UI!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Equipables[/b]
	
	Arcane forge now has a new type of item: equipables. Equipables are items that you can carry between runs and that are crafted with recipes. Equipables are common to all classes.
	
	[h1]Ingredients[/h1]
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Broken Shell[/b] - Used to craft Shell. This item has a rare chance of being dropped by Hives on the Sewers level.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Shell[/b] - Used to craft several items.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Magic Core[/b] - Used to craft Herberk's Pendant.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ninby's Essence/b] - Used to craft Ninby's Grace.
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Herberk's Jewel[/b] - Used to craft Herberk's Pendant. This item has a rare chance of being drop by Skeletal Mages(Necromancers) and Hydras.
	
	[h1]Recipes[/h1]
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Shell Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Common.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Herberk's Pendant Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Legendary.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ninby's Essence Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Rare.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ninby's Grace Recipe[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Legendary.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Magic Core[/b]
		[b][i]Recipe Rarity[/i]:[/b] Uncommon.
	
		
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]
	
	
	-[b]Collision Systems, huh?[/b] - Fixed a bug where the player would go outside of the boundaries of the dungeon. (We're still figuring out why players get stuck on walls, sorry!)
	-[b]Look Mom! I Just Crafted an Error![/b] - Fixed a bug where arcane forge would crash upon any item crafting.
	-[b]Arcane what? I just want to play the game...[/b] - Fixed a bug where arcane forge would crash upon starting the game (a.k.a. the old system to upgrade the save file has been re-introduced).


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	Here follows a list of all the known[h1]HOT-Fix v1 Details[/h1]

	-[b](TEMPORARY)[/b] Added a mechanism that automatically teleports the player out of a wall in case the player gets stuck. This mechanism is temporary and only exists to make the game playable whilst we fix the bug.
	-Fixed a bug where the Thief's Bombs where passing through enemies when the poltergeist dagger was equipped.
	-Fixed a bug where orbital items such as Vanguard, SpikeBall and EyeBall where disappearing when colliding with certain props.
	-Fixed a bug where the player would fail to teleport to the center of the room in The End.
	-Fixed a bug where the game would display an "Out of Memory" after a certain amount of time.

[h1]HOT-FIX v2 Details[/h1]

 -Fixed a bug where the player would fail to teleport to the center of the room in an "The End" dungeon;
 -Fixed a bug where the texture of previous levels would carry over to other levels and fail to refresh;
 -Fixed a bug where the Slime Boss would spawn slimes outside of the boundaries (on the walls);
 -Fixed a bug where a player could activate a special developer-tool by pressing a function key;
 -[b](NEW)[/b] Added an option to configure flavour text such as critical and life steal effects. You can toggle between "All", "Minimal" and "None" as options to show the texts. game would display an "Out of Memory" after a certain amount of time. issues and/or suggestions that we've taken a look into but were unable to fix for this patch. Hopefully, this list gets shorter with each patch :)

	
	[b]Known Issues[/b]
	-Due to the way the engineer behaves, his spider are dealing more damage than anticipated (each spider is dealing the displayed tooltip damage). We'll try to balance this issue out.
	-Some dungeons can spawn without any marks. We have special plans for this situation ;)
	-A new mechanic to cap the movement speed of heroes is needed, due to some of them still going sonic-like when using certain movement speed objects.
	-The game has performance issues on some areas.
	
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Multiplayer functionality. This feature is an end-development feature but we intend to make it happen!
	
	-A page on the main menu that allows you to view all the items you obtained during previous runs, as well as their descriptions. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!

notes.content:

Details of this section:
[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]

This is a hot-fix patch that also includes a few small suggestions to the game. In this patch, the average FPS got a boost!

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

[h1]Stats HUD[/h1]

When targeting a particular stat to level up, the HUD now displays the stat's full name.

[h1]Engineer[/h1]

[h1]Watch Your Step![/h1]

[b](NEW)[/b] When on corridors, mines will spawn either vertically or horizontally.

[h1]Items[/h1]
No changes performed.
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
No changes performed.

[b]NOTE:[/b] We know we haven't been implementing any new enemies, but we are keeping a close look at the suggestions! We're going to implement a few in the future, so don't worry if you think your suggestion isn't being read - we can assure you it is!
If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

-[b]Arcane Forge[/b]
The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Details of this section:
[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

-[b]It's a Trap![/b] - Fixed a bug where the engineer would collide with his own mines, therefore being unable to move.
-[b]Collision Systems, huh?[/b] - Fixed a bug where the player would get stuck on a wall when certain conditions were met.
-[b]I'd Like To FullScreen Please[/b] - Fixed a bug where the right analog stick of a gamepad would cease to work during fullscreen. Also, fixed a bug where the mouse would refuse to leave the corner of the screen when in full screen.
-[b]Don't Throw Me That Shade![/b] - Fixed a bug where the game would crash if the target operative system was unable to compile the required shaders.
-[b]FPS Rate[/b] - Increased base FPS rate. Now it should be higher than the average FPS rate available during patch 14.2

-[b]Collision Systems, huh?[/b] - Fixed a bug where the player would get stuck on a wall when certain conditions were met.

notes.title: Help us complete Dungeon Souls Character Information
notes.content:
[h1][b]Please help us complete Dungeon Souls Character Information![/b][/h1]

As we continue working on the game, we will need your help in completing Character's Stat Info. In order to do this, please follow below Character Sheet Format:

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]SAMPLE[/b]

[h1][b]ARCHER[/b][/h1]

[u]Presentation Letter[/u]: Ensure shot to any enemy, no matter how far 

[u]Main Attack[/u]: Arrow Shoot (LMB) is the default attack with the same speed of Thief the cool down speed is 0.33 seconds - the arrows inflict damage approximately 5-6 per hit 

[u]First Skill[/u]: Pentuple Arrow (Q) that shoots 5 arrows at a time - the skills damage is based on current damage base of the character and cool downs in 12 seconds 

[u]Second Skill[/u]: Rain Of Arrows (E) is the second skill that rains down plethora of 10 arrows down in any enemy - this guarantee wreck and create chaos in massive hordes of enemies even the bosses its cool down is 18 seconds. 

[u]Quirk[/u]: Can activate a buff which quintuples his short for a number of seconds or designate an area some distance away to receive a rain or arrows. 

[u]Gift[/u]: Second most accurate with 90% rate at start.

[h1]Happy Gaming![/h1]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #14.2
notes.content:
Details of this section:
[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]

Path 14.2 holds a few minor improvements to several areas of the game, so that the game is more stable for the upcoming big patch. We've made the tutorial a bit clearer so that players can learn how to play. Although very minor, these changes make the tutorial a bit better. Several bugs were fixed and the Redeemer's behavior has changed to a more aggressive state.

[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]

Improved the tutorial section so that it now has small objectives on each tutorial level. This should help new players to understand the game a bit better!

[h1]Bosses[/h1]

[h1]Lady Laine[/h1]

Now has voice lines and audio!

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

[h1]Thief[/h1]
    [b]Invisibility[/b]
    -Updated tooltip to display that each basic attack lowers the duration by 0.5 seconds.

[h1]Brawler[/h1]
    [b]Brawling Time[/b]
    -Updated tooltip to display that each attack deals % damage.

[h1]Nightblade[/h1]
    [b]Weapon Change[/b]
    -Fixed a bug where changing from the chakram back to the default weapon would lose the weapon's visual.

[h1]Items[/h1]

[b]([u]NEW[/u])Potion Pouch[/b]

[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Enables you to carry more potions on each slot.
[b][i]Item Stacking[/i]:[/b] Adds one more potion per stack.
[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198068131569]g3kk0 snuff[/url] for the item suggestion!

[b]Bleeding Eyeball[/b]

-Now deals mixed damage instead of flat physical damage. Also, a bug was fixed where it was using the player's magic damage.
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

[b]Redeemer[/b]

[b](NEW)[/b]Base-line behaviour of Redeemer has been changed. It now has a more aggressive behaviour (rushing towards the player as soon as he appears). It also has two more attack patterns to kill off the player quickly. 

WARNING: These attack patterns are not fair and are meant to almost insta-kill you :)

-[b]WOULD YOU BE SO KINDLY?[/b] - The strange tree (a.k.a. the tree that lets you traverse to the fae garden) no longer blocks paths, since you can now phase through it.

-[b]WHAT NONSENSE![/b] - You can no longer bind the same key to two different actions.
-Fixed a bug where laser staff and dragon tail couldn't be active at the same time.
-Fixed a bug where the eyeball item was stacking improperly. It now stacks capping at 6.

-Now deals mixed damage instead of flat physical damage. Also, a bug was fixed where it was using the player's magic damage.
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

[b]Redeemer[/b]

[b](NEW)[/b]Base-line behaviour of Redeemer has been changed. It now has a more aggressive behaviour (rushing towards the player as soon as he appears). It also has two more attack patterns to kill off the player quickly. 

WARNING: These attack patterns are not fair and are meant to almost insta-kill you :)

[b]NOTE:[/b] We know we haven't been implementing any new enemies, but we are keeping a close look at the suggestions! We're going to implement a few in the future, so don't worry if you think your suggestion isn't being read - we can assure you it is!

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

-[b]Arcane Forge[/b]
The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Details of this section:
[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

-[b]WOULD YOU BE SO KINDLY?[/b] - The strange tree (a.k.a. the tree that lets you traverse to the fae garden) no longer blocks paths, since you can now phase through it.

-[b]WHAT NONSENSE![/b] - You can no longer bind the same key to two different actions.
-Fixed a bug where laser staff and dragon tail couldn't be active at the same time.
-Fixed a bug where the eyeball item was stacking improperly. It now stacks capping at 6.
-Minor tailoring.

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
Here follows a list of all the known issues and/or suggestions that we've taken a look into but were unable to fix for this patch. Hopefully, this list gets shorter with each patch :)

[b]Known Issues[/b]
-Due to the way the engineer behaves, his spider are dealing more damage than anticipated (each spider is dealing the displayed tooltip damage). We'll try to balance this issue out.
-Some dungeons can spawn without any marks. We have special plans for this situation ;)
-A new mechanic to cap the movement speed of heroes is needed, due to some of them still going sonic-like when using certain movement speed objects.
-The game has performance issues on some areas.

[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

Details of this section:
[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]

-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!

-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!

-Multiplayer functionality. This feature is an end-development feature but we intend to make it happen!

-A page on the main menu that allows you to view all the items you obtained during previous runs, as well as their descriptions. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #14.1
notes.content:
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 14.1 brings some new content, as well as changes to previous mechanics of the game. We intend to start making the game less repetitive without changing too much of the core of the game. We'll keep doing these changes and see if you guys like it or not. We would also like to apologize for the delay of this patch (since it should have been out last week)! ːsteamsadː
	
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Item Stacking Information[/b]
		Added a new mechanism that tells you the amount of stacks that an item has when viewing that item's description. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!
		Using the mouse scroll now cycles between skills, independant of their position. We'll be also trying to implement this for controllers as well (without forgetting the quick-casting) and also create an option to enable/disable this behaviour. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	[b]Spike Traps[/b]
		Spikes traps now have a delayed activation speed when near other spike traps.
		
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Notification System[/b]
		Added a notification system where the player can get notified of certain events. For example, whenever you unlock a character, you'll get a notification of that event!
		
	[b]Fire Traps[/b]
		Now only fire when the player is within range (i.e.: when they appear on the player's screen).
		
	[b]Game Resolution[/b]
		Changed from full scaling back to aspect ratio.
		
	[b]Marks[/b]
		Now marks spawn random sets of monsters instead of a fixed type. For example, a mark can now spawn 6 bats and 2 ghosts when activated, instead of 8 bats. We're doing this to change a bit of the "repetitiveness" of the game. Tell us what you think of this in the comments or in the forums! :happysteam:
		
	[b]Boulder Traps[/b]
		Now display "Watch out!" text instead of "Click!" text when activated. Hopefully, this helps newcommers to dodge it!

		
[h1]Items[/h1]

	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Blind Blade[/b]
	A cursed reapier like blade.
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] When striking an enemy, provides a 50% chance to deal double damage or no damage at all.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Forsendonteverbuythiskappa]DeCypher[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Blizzard Cape[/b]
	
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Creates a strong blizzard surrounding the player. Enemies inside the area receive 15 damage each second. Duplicates all slowing effects caused on the player.
	[b][i]Item Stacking[/i]:[/b] 2 (adds a 40% chance to slow enemies hit)
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herberk[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/louisphgamer]louisph123[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Spiked Shoes[/b]
	Metallic spike shoes.
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] These shoes are resilient to your attacks' knockback. They also provide add 5% movement speed.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198053396930]Revo[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Dragon's Tail[/b]
	The spirit of the dragon is yours.
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] On attack, 15% chance to cast a fireball that deals 150% magic damage
	[b][i]Item Stacking[/i]:[/b] 3 (adds 15% chance and 50% magic damage, up to 45% chance of casting with 250% magic damage)
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198180033302]KoroSensei2003[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

	[b]NOTE:[/b] We know we haven't been implementing any new enemies, but we are keeping a close look at the suggestions! We're going to implement a few in the future, so don't worry if you think your suggestion isn't being read - we can assure you it is!

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

-[b]Arcane Forge[/b] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ectoplasm[/b] 
		Added a new ingredient to the arcane forge! It only drops from ghosts.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Bone[/b] 
		Added a new ingredient to the arcane forge! It only drops from skeletal enemies (including the boss).
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])A Tiny Bit Enhanced[/b] 
		Arcane forge now displays the key bindings you need to press to navigate through the menus. These menus are not final and we intend to change them, but for now, it should suffice ːsteamhappyː
		Arcane forge now also displays the type of weapon each hero can equip, next to their portrait.
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Poltergeist Bow Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a poltergeist bow that makes arrows pierce up to 3 enemies. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the item suggestion!
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Poltergeist Dagger Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a poltergeist dagger that pierces up to 3 enemies. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the item suggestion!
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Poltergeist Staff Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a poltergeist staff that pierces up to 3 enemies. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the item suggestion!
		
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
	
	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

	-[b]ARE YOU OKAY?[/b] - (Hopefully) Fixed a bug where slime gigantulum stopped attacking all of a sudden.
	-[b]IT LOOKS LIKE A STAR![/b] - Fixed a bug where auto-pick would continously display the effect of picking up a potion, even though it couldn't.
	-Fixed a bug where the red devil would cause the game to crash on certain conditions.
	-Fixed a bug where the ice axe was displaying the wrong description.
	
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]

	Here follows a list of all the known issues and/or suggestions that we've taken a look into but were unable to fix for this patch. Hopefully, this list gets shorter with each patch :)

	
	[b]Known Issues[/b]
	-Due to the way the engineer behaves, his spider are dealing more damage than anticipated (each spider is dealing the displayed tooltip damage). We'll try to balance this issue out.
	-The strange tree on the ice level seems to be blocking some players' path. We'll attempt to fix this issue as fast as possible.
	-You can bind the same keyboard key to two or more controls. We'll make it so this is not possible.
	-Some dungeons can spawn without any marks. We have special plans for this situation ;)
	-A new mechanic to cap the movement speed of heroes is needed, due to some of them still going sonic-like when using certain movement speed objects.
	-The game has performance issues on some areas.
	
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Multiplayer functionality. This feature is an end-development feature but we intend to make it happen!
	
	-A page on the main menu that allows you to view all the items you obtained during previous runs, as well as their descriptions. Thanks to Steam users [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197984611885]QwiK[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!
	

For assistance please e-mail us at [u]laminastudios@gmail.com[/u]

Thank You!

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #14
notes.content:
[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 14 adds a lot of new story elements. Merlin's side story is completed, which explains the main story as well. Also, a few bug fixes were applied. Fullscreen has been supported without the black bars (sacrificing aspect ratio).
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

[h1]General[/h1]

	Removed Gigantulum Slime's audio files. Soon, voice lines will be changed and new voice acting will be introduced.
	More metalic props now drop metal scrap.
	[b]BEGONE BLACK BARS[/b]: Now the game fits the whole window. As such, the game does not respect aspect ratio (meaning if you have a really broad resolution, sprites may look stretched).
	[b]SHIELDS![/b]: The game now possess a shield mechanic. The shield acts like extra health points that do not normally regenerate and that do not have a limit.
	[b]NOW 10% EASIER![/b]: Easy mode now spawns the player with a shield that has 20 hit points.
	[b]ITEM AUTO-PICK[/b]: Now responds faster to items, picking them at a faster pace.

[h1]Levels[/h1]
	
	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Forbidden Chambers[/b]
		-A special place where the player might meet after completing Forbidden Library and certain conditions. 
		
[h1]Items[/h1]

	[b]([u]NEW[/u])Recommendation Letter[/b]
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Enables the user to buy an aditional item on the store. Stacks cap at 2, enabling the purchase of 3 items.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198053707911]Ahtrial[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

	[b]Judgement[/b]:
		-Voice lines updated due to story elements.
		
	[b]Soul Guardian[/b]:
		-Voice lines updated due to story elements.

	[b]Merlin[/b]:
		-Reduced base health from 1200 to 700.
		-Balanced damage output.
		-Increased reaction time between spells.
		
	[b]Other[/b]:
		-Some other bosses were added, but we won't tell you which (wouldn't be fun otherwise)! ːsteamhappyː

Dungeon Souls Update #13.4
notes.content:
READ THESE UPDATES! GAME SAVES MAY BE AFFECTED!

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 13.4 brings some balancing and bug fixes. Arcane forge's item indexing has been replaced and has new recipes. You can now also grind for materials more easilly. The overvall difficulty was increased with each loop, however and some balancing changes were added. New story elements were added.
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

[h1]Save File[/h1]

	[b]WARNING! READ CAREFULLY:[/b] Because of the way art assets are handled in the game engine, the indexing in arcane forge was going off (resulting in some corrupt weapons). To fix this, we changed the indexing of arcane forge, but as a result, we had to clear the its weapons and items, so you will lose all crafted weapons. We're truly sorry for any incovenience that this might cause. You should receive a message when starting the game that states it will apply the fix.

[h1]General[/h1]

	Changed the judgement level's background music.
	[b]Let's see you cry[/b] - Increased the power increase between each loop for enemies by A LOT from difficulty Normal to Nightmare, therefor increasing the difficulty between each loop.
	[b]Gimme That Sweet Loot![/b] - Some props now have a chance to drop materials when destroyed.
	[b]Move Please[/b] - Game window now has borders so that you can relocate the game window.
	[b]Are you sure?[/b] - Quick Restart now asks for confirmation before quick-restarting.
	[b]Are you sure?[/b] - Returning to the Main Menu now asks for confirmation before returning.
	
[h1]Stats[/h1]

	Renamed the stat [b]SPD(speed)[/b] to [b]MSP(movement speed)[/b], for clarification purposes. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Ninby]Ninby[/url] for the suggestion!

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

-[b]Theif:[/b]

	[b][i]Invisibility[/i][/b]
		-Attacking during stealth now reduces the stealth duration by 0.5 with each attack. This change makes it so that the thief cannot perma-stealth throughout the runs.

-[b]Brawler:[/b]

	[b][i]Spinning Death[/i][/b]
		-Now grants 30 defense instead of invulnerability;
		-Duration increases by 1 per 3 levels.
		-Skill's cooldown now starts at the end of cast.

	Duelist's visual re-made.
		
-[b]Cleric:[/b]

	[b][i]Gate[/i][/b]
		-Fixed a bug where the cooldown of the non-neophyte cleric was higher than intended.
		
[h1]Items[/h1]

	[b]Beaker[/b]
	-Now gives 10+5x stack_amount hp per 5x stack_amount enemies killed.
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

	[b]Judgement[/b]:
		-Now has voice lines!

	[b]Ghost[/b]:
	-Greatly reduced spawn rate on first loop.

	[b]Gimme That Sweet Loot![/b] - Bosses now drop materials upon death.

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

-[b]Arcane Forge[/b] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Shard[/b] 
		New crafting material.
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Sword Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft an ice sword that gives a chance of freezing enemies.
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Staff Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft an ice staff that gives a chance of freezing enemies.
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Dagger Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft an ice dagger that gives a chance of freezing enemies.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Scepter Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft an ice scepter that gives a chance of freezing enemies.
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Bow Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft an ice bow that gives a chance of freezing enemies.
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Ice Axe Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft an ice axe that gives a chance of freezing enemies.
		
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
	
	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

	-[b]ALIGN YOURSELF[/b] - Fixed a bug where skill description display was being misaligned (mostly in Mac and Linux, but also on some versions of windows).
	-[b]I DIDN'T HAVE A TWIN![/b] - Fixed a bug where picking the Fallen Soldier's Shield would cause to pick it up duplicated.
	-[b]ALCHEMICAL-INSTABILITY[/b] - Fixed a bug where certain items would not transmute into materials/gold/exp.
	-[b]SHUT UP[/b] - Fixed a bug where boss voice overs would overlap.
	-[b]A LOOP? SO SOON?[/b] - Fixed a bug where progressing through a loop (second,third,etc.) on a run and leaving to the menu would cause the loop to be carried over to the next run.
	-[b]THAT IS THE WRONG COLOR![/b] - Fixed a bug where the compass' second upgrade was not displaying cursed chests correctly.
	-[b]KEEP UP WITH THE TIME[/b] - Fixed a bug where hero default weapons were not being updated after the hero had reached the neophyte weapon.
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]

	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!

[h1]We would like to inform everyone that Dungeon Souls is now under Lamina Studios.[/h1]


Thank you!

-Dungeon Souls Team-

[h1]Save File[/h1]

	[b]WARNING! READ CAREFULLY:[/b] Because of the addition of the new heroes, the save-file configuration had to be replaced. However, an update-mechanism was added. This mechanism should automatically detect that your save file is an older version (if it is the case) and update it, without resetting any progress. A message should appear saying that the save file was updated. IF  the message does not appear, either you are playing a fresh version of the game, or your save file might be corrupted.

[h1]Menu[/h1]

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Arcane Forge:[/b] Added a new entry to the main menu to go to the Arcane Forge.

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

	The brawler is a fast-paced class that excels in dealing damage around himself and quickly striking his foes! You can unlock him by defeating over 500 enemies in game! You can also check his abilities in the
	character select preview.

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Engineer:[/b]

	The engineer is a slow-paced, heavy damage-dealer hero that uses his spider bots and mine fields to blow up foes! You can unlock him by finding the "Rockets!" item. You can also check his abilities in the character
	select preview.
-[b]Necromancer:[/b]

	Changed the look of the necromancer's skeletons so that they are distinguishable from enemy skeletons.
	
-[b]Nightblade:[/b]

	Fixed a bug where nightblade's first ability was dealing more damage than intended.

[h1]Items[/h1]
	
-[b]Item Stacking ([u]BETA MECHANISM[/u]):[/b] Item stacking now has a chance to give materials for arcane forge, as well as gold and experience!

-[b]([u]NEW CLASS[/u])Recipes[/b]

	Patch 13.3 has a lot of changes to inner gameplay elements. Arcane forge has been added to the game, as well as two new heroes. Some other story elements were added, as well as new background music for certain levels.
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

[h1]Save File[/h1]

	[b]WARNING! READ CAREFULLY:[/b] Because of the addition of the new heroes, the save-file configuration had to be replaced. However, an update-mechanism was added. This mechanism should automatically detect that your save file is an older version (if it is the case) and update it, without resetting any progress. A message should appear saying that the save file was updated. IF  the message does not appear, either you are playing a fresh version of the game, or your save file might be corrupted.

[h1]Menu[/h1]

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Arcane Forge:[/b] Added a new entry to the main menu to go to the Arcane Forge.

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Brawler:[/b]

	The brawler is a fast-paced class that excels in dealing damage around himself and quickly striking his foes! You can unlock him by defeating over 500 enemies in game! You can also check his abilities in the
	character select preview.

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Engineer:[/b]

	The engineer is a slow-paced, heavy damage-dealer hero that uses his spider bots and mine fields to blow up foes! You can unlock him by finding the "Rockets!" item. You can also check his abilities in the character
	select preview.
-[b]Necromancer:[/b]

	Changed the look of the necromancer's skeletons so that they are distinguishable from enemy skeletons.
	
-[b]Nightblade:[/b]

	Fixed a bug where nightblade's first ability was dealing more damage than intended.

[h1]Items[/h1]
	
-[b]Item Stacking ([u]BETA MECHANISM[/u]):[/b] Item stacking now has a chance to give materials for arcane forge, as well as gold and experience!

-[b]([u]NEW CLASS[/u])Recipes[/b] 
	A new class of items were added called "Recipe". These are used to forge items in the arcane forge.
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Arcane Forge[/b] 

	The arcane forge is a place where you can forge items and weapons to use in future runs for your heroes. You do so by using recipes collected in the Forbidden Library (random drop from monsters) and
	by collecting materials from your runs. Whenever an item reaches full stack, it will drop ingredients to be used on the arcane forge! Thanks to everyone who contributed, specially to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Fire Sword Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a fire sword that gives a chance of burning enemies.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Fire Axe Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a fire axe that gives a chance of burning enemies.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Fire Bow Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a fire biw that gives a chance of burning enemies.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Fire Scepter Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a fire scepter that gives a chance of burning enemies.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Fire Staff Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a fire staff that gives a chance of burning enemies.
		
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Fire Dagger Recipe[/b] 
		A recipe to craft a fire dagger that gives a chance of burning enemies.
		
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
	
	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

	-[b]NO MORE SONIC:[/b]Fixed a bug where using shoes of haste and footfinger would create an insane movement-speed boost and essencially break the game.
	-[b]SHOW ME YOUR HEALTH:[/b]Fixed a bug where the judgement's second form was not displaying health bar. All bosses spawning on judgement's boss fight now display a mini-health bar above them.
	-[b]REPEAT OR NOT REPEAT:[/b]Fixed a bug where potions were not transforming into gold/experience correctly.
	-Several minor bug-fixes were applied.
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	

For immediate assistance, please contact us via e-mail: mike.gamesdev@gmail.com 

Thank you once again for your patience and continued support.

-Dungeon Souls Team-

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #12.8
notes.content:
NOTE
[spoiler]We're trying a new layout for the patch notes. Tell us if you like it![/spoiler]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Patch 12.8 contains few changes to the game and an addition of a few features and items, as well as some bug fixes. We intended to fix some bugs and small issues that we found on the previous versions, so that the game becomes more stable. We are also readying the alchemy lab concept for the next update! 
	
	Two new heroes are expected to come in the next patch as well (if everything goes accordingly)!
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]

[h1]Menu[/h1]

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Smooth Camera:[/b] You can enable/disable the smooth camera movement, just in case you get headaches! Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/nnnopee]nnnope[/url] for the suggestion!
-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Vertical Sync:[/b] You can enable/disable vertical synchronization in case your game is having screen-tearing issues.

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

[h1]Items[/h1]
	
-[b]Item Stacking ([u]BETA MECHANISM[/u]):[/b] Whenever the player picks an item, if it cannot stack, it will be converted into either gold or experience. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Lightningbros]Lightningbros[/url] for the suggestion!

-[b]Potion Slots:[/b] Potion slots now allow stacks of two of the same item. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!

-[b]Blood On Foot:[/b] Changed name to "Bloody Rabbit's Foot". Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Lightningbros]Lightningbros[/url] for the suggestion!

-[b]Compass:[/b] Now stacks up to two times. On second pick-up, displays the location of chests on the mini-map. Thanks to Steam user Yannik Langener for the suggestion!

-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Shoes of Haste:[/b]
	Double your speed, but makes the Reddemer spawn immediatly once the final portal is activate.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/louisphgamer]louisph123[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Redeemer's Essence:[/b]
	Redeemer takes twice as long to appear due to the presence of his essence.
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Redeemer takes twice as long to appear.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Uncommon
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/louisphgamer]louisph123[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
-[b]([u]NEW[/u])The Northern Hat:[/b]
	Reduces all freezing effects by 20% and increases defense by 3.
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] -20% slow effect; +3 defense
	[b][i]Item Stacking[/i]:[/b] 8 (adds 10% to the effect and 4 to the defense, up to 50% slow reduction and 15 defense)
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare
	[b][i]Hidden Passive[/i]:[/b] Adds ", eh!" at the end of in-game speech.
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/louisphgamer]louisph123[/url] for the item suggestion!

-[b]Shop:[/b]
	-Reduced spawn chance of common items. Increased chance for uncommon and rare items.
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]

If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
	
	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

	-Item "Green Meat Cube" now has the correct outline colour;
	-Ability cooldowns now have a black outline for easier reading. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sebastiannemeth]Zior[/url] for the suggestion!
	-Fixed a bug where getting damaged would sometimes cause a crash in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198044989740]JONSNOW[/url] for the suggestion!
	-Fixed a bug where red-scarf's slow chance reduction was not being applied;
	-Fixed a bug where Rusty Sword was applying more bonus damage than intended;
	-Butterfly wings now display the damage output. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198059560833]Ninby[/url] for the suggestion!
	-Reduced the spawn rate of ghosts on the first levels.
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-[b](ON THE WORKS)[/b] An alchemy lab that would require gold and materials collected in other runs. These would be used to create special items for the next run (or even as a vault). Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!
	
Thank you!

-Dungeon Souls Team-

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #12.7
notes.content:
NOTE
[spoiler]We're trying a new layout for the patch notes. Tell us if you like it![/spoiler]

[h1]Scope[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the scope of what patches were made in the current version.[/spoiler]
	
	Several changes were made in patch [b]12.7[/b]. We redesigned the controller layout so that the player no longer feels like they are fighting the layout scheme, instead of playing the game. We've also included some more story elements and fixed several bugs, as well as an FPS increase.
	
[h1]Game Elements[/h1]
	
	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the latest changes to any game elements, such as items, enemies, controls, menus and much more![/spoiler]

[h1]Heroes[/h1]
	Reduced stat points gained from neophyte progress. Now can only gain up to 2 more stat points. For clarification purposes, the stat point increase is as follows:
	-If the neophyte level is lower than 2 you gain 1 stat point, elsewise you gain 2.
	-Per 10 levels, you gain 1 extra stat point. This bonus caps at 2.

[h1]Items[/h1]
-[b]Bane Scepter[/b]
	Now gives 3 stat points and 2 skill points in exchange for 25% of maximum hp.
-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Vital Armor[/b]
	When hit, it has a chance of either healing the incoming damage or doubling the incoming damage.
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Cursed
-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Angel Feather[/b]
	Brings you back to life if you die, getting consumed in the process.
	[b][i]Item Effect[/i]:[/b] Revives the player with 30% of maximum hp.
	[b][i]Item Stacking[/i]:[/b] 8 (adds 10% to the effect, up to 100% of maximum hp)
	[b][i]Item Class[/i]:[/b] Rare
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the item suggestion!
	
If you want to suggest more items, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/535152276588247441/]item suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!	

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
-[b]([u]NEW[/u])Explosive Slime[/b]
	Acts like a normal slime, having a reddish color with black spots, but when it gets close to the player, it detonates, with a 1.5 second detonation timer, and explodes.
	[b][i]Spawning Area[/i]:[/b] Slime Dungeon
	[b][i]HP[/i]:[/b] 15
	[b]Special Thanks:[/b] Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the enemy suggestion!
	
If you want to suggest more enemies, please visit the  [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/383230/discussions/0/405694115210792937/]enemy suggestion[/url] thread and share your ideas!

[h1]Gamepad Layout[/h1]

	The previous gamepad layout posed quite a few problems that were creating frustrations when playing the game. The fact that you needed to use the gamepad as a cursor would make most reactions really slow and generally unintuitive. With this layout, we hope that these problems are gone for good!

[b]Better Aiming:[/b]Now the right stick automatically assigns the direction that the hero's weapon is facing towards.
[b]([u]NEW[/u])Skill Level Up:[/b]A new menu was created in order to make it easier for gamepad players to level up their skills (cursor is no longer needed). To cycle between abilities, you can use the right stick. To upgrade an ability, use the accept button.
[b]Stat Increase:[/b]No longer uses cursor to level up stats. Instead, you can use the right stick to move up and down between stat upgrades.
[b]Inventory:[/b]You can now use the right stick to check each item's description and effects.
[b]Right Stick Lock:[/b]When either the skills, stats or inventory menu are opened, the right stick does not let the player aim. This is so that you can interact with the menus without background movement of the camera.
[b]([u]NEW[/u])Skill Menu Button:[/b]Added a new configurable button to open/close the skill menu button.

[h1] Extra Notes [/h1]

[h1]FPS[/h1]
	The average FPS in-game (meaning, the fps that you have when in the dungeon) has been increased. For a comparison, in the last patch the average fps on the testing computer ranged from 60-90, where in some cases it would go below 60 and in others it would reach 100. Now, it ranges from 80-90 to 100-130, with worst case scenario being 60-70 FPS and best 130-140 FPS.
	
	Keep in mind that these are the results obtained on the testing computer and may differ between each computer!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
	
	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section contains the bug fixes that were applied in issues detected in the previous versions.[/spoiler]

	-Fixed a bug that would cause the necromancer's skeletons to crash the game if certain requirements were meant (Redeemer apologizes for the incovenience!);
	-Fixed a bug where the Gigantum Slime would appear to teleport/jump in the middle of an attack;
	-Fixed a bug where some elements in the Slime Dungeon would cause extreme FPS drop;
	-Skill descriptions now display the improvements per level;
	-Fixed a bug where melee attacks were not destroying projectiles;
	-Fixed a bug where the thief's basic attack was not scalling correctly (or at all);
	-Fixed a bug where the potions in the potion bar were not displaying their correct sprite;
	-Reduced the sound created by the item 'Battery';
	-[b]([u]NEW[/u]):[/b] Added a beta mechanism that automatically saves the player's progress when playing in the dungeon. This is so that if there is a crash because of a bug, not all progress is lost. It is not a mechanism that will be present in the final version of the game (at least, it is not planned).
	
[h1]Considerations In Up-Comming Patches[/h1]

	Details of this section:
	[spoiler]This section describes the suggestion that are being taken into account during the next patches. It does [b]not[/b] mean that they will be implemented fully (or even at all). However, it does mean that we liked the idea and will try to implement it! :)[/spoiler]
	
	-An alchemy lab that would require gold and materials collected in other runs. These would be used to create special items for the next run (or even as a vault). Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-A GUI that displays buffs/debuffs and extra information about what's going on in the game. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Herbrek]Herbrek[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198208417113]Xerxes Asuras[/url] for the suggestion!
	
	-Quick save and quick load feature. Thanks to Steam user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/sakuyakudo]kierasam[/url] for the suggestion!

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #12.4
notes.content:
This patch fixes small bugs found in patch version 12.3. It also adds a bit of new content!

[General]

-Fixed a bug that caused the game to give an error when redeemer appeared under certain conditions;

-Fixed a bug with the logging system;

-Fixed a bug that caused the game to give an error when PWizard was alive under certain conditions;

-Fixed an error that occured when the game detected that the player's save file was corrupted, but no back up files are present to revert;

-Reduced stat point gain increased from leveling up. Now caps at two, gaining 1 per 10 levels;

-Now only basic ranged attacks block enemy projectiles, instead of all kinds of projectiles (such as abilities);


[Item Suggestion Thread]

A huge thanks to Snorlaxxo for the following item ideas:

-[NEW] Item class - Cursed. Cursed items give a massive boost/effect, in trade for a massive downgrade of another stat/effect. They can only be found inside cursed chests.

-[NEW] Chest - Cursed Chest. Has 80% chance to spawn a cursed item, with 2% chance of spawning on a dungeon level.

[NEW][Amplifying Tome]

Description: Makes your damage dealing spells a lot stronger, but highly increases their cooldown.

Effect: +200% mixed damage increase on damage dealing spells, +100% cooldown on damage dealing spells.

Rarity: Purple (Cursed)

[NEW][Scepter of Power]

Description: Gives an insane damage boost, but harshly lowers HP.

Effect: +200% Mixed damage, -50% MAX HP. These effects are refresh upon stat increase and level up.

Rarity: Purple (Cursed)

[FUTURE UPDATE]

We would like to notify everyone that the next patch will be available by the end of this week. We would like to take a bit of a time to check on the issues/bugs reported carefully.

Thank you very much for your untiring support and feedback to help us improve the game.


-Dungeon Souls Team-

notes.title: Update #10
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone for bearing with us. It has been a while since the last update, and we are doing the best to improve your Dungeon Souls gaming experience. There will be more improvements of  the game including the design, story, controller implementation and configuration, multiplayer and many more.

Update #10 includes: 

- Controller Support 
  (Xbox One & 360 and Generic controllers)
- Tutorial
- Keyboard+Mouse Config Tab (will not work if controller is plugged in)
- Controller Config Tab (continued test of controllers)
- Improved FPS and optimization
- Alienware implementation (currently removed due to running game issue)
- new arrow trap visual art 
- reduced the chance for potions to drop 
- new enemy (soul stealer) --> not as a new class (this is a correction)
- some props don't drop coins anymore 
- necromancer skin - fairies are now animated 
- reduced key drop chance 
- rebalanced nightblade's abilities 
- corpses now fly

Special Mention: We are currently working on the classes and levels so please hang in there.

We are continuously working on the implementation of other controllers and preparing the game for full release. There will  be a lot more to look forward to and we are very much dedicated to making the game even better.

Thank you very much for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #9
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/to8TjwM.png[/img]

Here are the update details:

- New HUD
- New WIP Boss
- New wall visual art
- Added some new sound effects
- Reduced the speed of arrow trap projectiles
- Merlin’s hat now adds 10 magic resistance
- Hallway arch is now back
- Traveler’s cloak should now add magic resist and not magic damage
- Boulder’s appear a little bit longer
- Lights are now less messy
- Opening map should not slow down your game anymore
- Added flames on fireball traps
- Enemy health bars only appear when hit and disappears in a certain amount of time
- King’s crown now gives you 15 bonus damage and 10 bonus damage
- Reduced the damage of arrow traps
- Leaving options menu should not make your game blurry anymore
- Added potion slots which can be used by pressing keys 1,2 and 3 (these keys can’t be changed for now)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We know that it has been a while since the last update. We have taken the time to review your comments/suggestions. We also have been also watching some of the gameplays and read the game reviews so we can implement those that you have shared with us. We appreciate your patience and participation every week. We enjoyed your collaboration in this project with your thoughts that help us to enhance the game and add as much to make it better. 

We apologize if we have missed some of your questions, but we go over them and we try to reply as soon as we can. We are still working on some of your suggestions/comments and for the controller support and other platforms, these will really need some time for us to be able to implement. However, please know that we are not disregarding them we are just trying to do as much in terms of balancing the game and making it more convenient for you. 

We will keep you posted that is for sure to know what we are working on and we will be always in touch so please do keep your comments/suggestions coming. Please send us an e-mail at mike.gamesdev@gmail.com or agp@mike-studios.com for any issues/bugs or if you’d like to reach out to us. 

Once again, thank you and we look forward to your feedback.

Thank you,

Mike Studios

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #8 - More Fixes and Balances
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZKKiklR.png[/img]

How is it going guys?

Sorry for the delay in update. We were supposed to release an update last week but Mike has been busy preparing for the IGDA Manila meetup because he was chosen to be one of the speakers. One of our team members took all your suggestions/recommendations/comments to keep track of the updates.
If we were not so active in the discussions in the past weeks it is because we are also busy preparing for some other things.

If there are other things that we haven't included yet in this patch especially those have been posted in the discussion, we will go over it again and include them on the next patch. :)

Here are the changes made:

- New magic and active items!
- Enemies in Boss Room and Judgement's Big Projectiles now has chance to drop potions
- Lady Laine now drops big chest
- Lock pick now gives you 25% chance to open all chests
- Increased chance for enemies to drop potions
- Reduced laser beams' knockback
- Item acquired popup text is now back
- Leveling up now increases your maximum hp by 5% 
- Merlin's hat now gives you 10 magic resistance
- Laser staff should now display "20% chance" not "20 chance" and gives you 5 magic damage
- Necromancer's skellies can't be stuck on walls anymore when summoned
- Map frame can now be enable/disable
- Use items now has their own outline color
- Fallen Soldier Shield should now have a green outline
- Reduced number of traps but still are dangerous
- Reduced the range of arrow traps

Thank you so much everyone!

Mike Studios

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #6 - HOTFIX
notes.content:
I've been reading all your comments/suggestions and discussions posted. Some find the new level generation too open and boring since enemies are not constantly spawning so i've decided to revert back not the level generation but the constant spawning of enemies. Instead of spawning everywhere, enemies just spawn in the rooms. 

I've also made some fixes to the game. :)

- Fixed Level Generation
- Zombie tooth doesn't take your base regen off anymore
- Soul orb won't drop on Golden Chest anymore
- Coins and gems now has their distinct values
- Enemies constantly spawn again, but only in rooms
- Coins now are automatically added
- Necromancer can now be ranked up again
- Fairies are back again
- Potions now spawn when you have an Empty Bottle Item

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #5 - Secrets!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/uDWnRDs.png[/img]

We would to thank everyone for your untiring cooperation and support. We have been busy a lot lately and we would like to let you know that we are going to be busy again for the coming week, but as we continue to update the game more and more features will be added and we need extra time to implement all that is expected in the game.

Please posts your suggestions/comments by creating bugs/issues thread. Also, a separate thread provided to classify topics in order for us to easily classify them.

Here are the details for Update #5:

- Secret Levels!
- Added New Items
- Reduced amount of snow in the Snow Cavern
- Frost Caverns new tiles
- Fixed the bug when acquiring beating brain
- Add a little sign board on the shop
- You cannot change 2 keys at a time
- Added exp and money counter
- Floating text are now color coded 
(Red: damaged taken | Yellow: Critical | Blue: Double damage | White: Normal Damage)
- Enable and Disable Glow
- Elite and Champion enemies doesn’t drop chest anymore instead it gives you large amount of exp
- Twin Blade stack chance by 2% instead of 30%
- Rusty sword now has a bleed chance
- Clearer item descriptions
- Vanguard don’t stack but spawn 3 shield when obtained
- Removed potions inn the Boss room, instead, we made an item which grants you 4 random potions in the beginning of boss battle
- Necromancer can now unlocked by killing 15 skeletons.

Additional:
Dungeon Souls is now available for Linux based OS

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #4
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZXXIb62.png[/img]

We would like to thank each and every one of you who participated in the discussion and for all the suggestions/comments you have shared. Also, for those who have contacted us via e-mail, chat or via Facebook to report the bugs/issues encountered, we appreciate you for letting us know right away. This helped us a lot in the process of updating/polishing the game. 

With Update #4, we tried to resolve as many bugs/issues encountered (posted on discussion or reported via e-mail/chat) and implemented some of your suggestions. If there is anything that we missed, please let us know by posting a new post “Bugs/Issues” so we can easily check it there. If there is anything that needs urgent attention (you can send us an e-mail at agp@mike-studios.com or mike.gamesdev@gmail.com. 

•	Other attacks doesn’t decrease Necro’s HP aside from his own attack
•	The character should not be able to get invisible when on the top most wall.
•	Fixed Arrow, Fireball and Knife throw collision mask
•	When axe is picked it should now appear in the inventory 
•	Item will no longer appear near the portal
•	Fixed the issue on critical chance:
o	Formula: critical chance += (n%/100)
•	Critical chance can now be seen in the stats screen
•	Wizard class can now be unlocked in any difficulty but not on EASY level.
•	Fixed the bug when upgrading passive skill
•	Spikeball will not multiply anymore when picked up instead it stacks it’s damage
•	Hammer, Rusty Sword now gives you +2% damage and stack
•	Better shooting at hallways
•	Wooden shield now gives you +10% bonus defense
•	Lifesteal and Blood for Attack only work in normal attacks
•	You now gain 50% EXP on EASY level and 300% on Nightmare level
•	Eyeball will not multiply instead it will increase its attack damage
•	New enemy type on Frozen Caverns
•	Ice Golem doesn’t spawn normal ice block
•	New class has been added (Check it out!)
•	Changed screen flash effect
•	Fixed the effect of stun
•	Reduced duration of Invisibility
•	Thornmail now deals damage to nearby enemies instead of dealing damage on collision
•	Access Options menu in the Pause screen!


HOW CRIT CHANCE WORK:
item crit chance = +50% crit chance += (50/100) crit chance += 0.5% 
*This works the same on the items that gives bonus damage/defense

For those who are still waiting for the controller support and resolution options, we are still working on it. We are trying our best to update as much as we can every week and we are also working now on making the game available for Mac and Linux soon. We will post an announcement as soon as this becomes available. 

We greatly appreciate your patience and understanding. 

On behalf of our team, our sincerest thank you to all of you.


-Mike Studios Team-

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #3
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/MWmeC3Q.png[/img]

First off, we would like to thank everyone for your participation in the discussion. We have been following the thread, read your posts and watched every gameplay so we can understand everyone’s perspective. However, we also discussed about the different aspects of the game where we will be able to generate a fair game for you to play. We understand that not all of you are happy with the previous patch but, we did try to reach out explaining future plans for the game. 

As we progress in the development, we are also starting to bring in more into the game to make it more exciting, fun, and adventurous for you to enjoy. We are very happy about your feedback and suggestions because it opens more portals of imagination for us.  It is something we are grateful for having such an involved community. 

We are proceeding with positive thoughts of making the game even better and with your patience and continued participation we will also continue doing our job well.

•	Balanced Red Devil’s damage
•	Fixed Cleric's regeneration bug where it stack when you use it
•	You can now use (“Q” and “E”) or (“Mouse Wheel”) to set abilities and “RMB” to cast
•	Redeemer will now suck 0.001% of hero’s Max HP
•	Elite enemies will have greater 50% Max HP  instead of x2 Max HP
•	Blood for attack will now drain 1% of hero’s HP and increase by 0.5% instead of increasing it by 1%
•	Removed the bug regarding the Ally Soul
•	Changed the color of slimes and the lights in the Sewers
•	Improved how CHANCES work in the game
•	Added tooltip for difficulties
•	Changed Redeemer’s blood suck art style
•	Reduced Unicorn Horn’s chance to deal 999 damage
•	Improved Necromancer’s Skeleton AI
•	New Items and Rare ones
•	Reduced chance to launch a rocket when Rocket Item is acquired
•	Changed Door to Portal
•	30% chance to find golden chest and 50% chance for metal/silver chest
•	Drops of Golden and Silver chest are now more worthy
•	Bosses and Enemies now has chance to stun you
•	Fixed Skeleton Fire Burst hit box
•	Character turns purple when poisoned
•	Fixed Merlin’s Hat item effect
•	Added superior type of enemy in the Nightmare Difficulty
•	Item are now AUTO-PICK
•	Elite and superior enemy don’t drop items in the boss room
•	Boulder trap marks are now red
•	Upgrade you passive skills
•	Upgrade rank by earning points from killed enemy, bosses, collected loots and items
•	*NOTE: Points is not saved when you exit to main menu.
•	Rank titles and icons!
•	Added an option to disable and enable auto-cast
•	“Enabled” – cast skills automatically with “Q” or “E” key or any key you’ve assigned
•	“Disabled” – use right mouse button to cast and mouse wheel to scroll
•	Characters are unlocked in NORMAL MODE/DIFFICULTY
•	You can navigate on the menu by using "W","S", and "Space". In preparation for the controller support.

Future update include:
•	Soul orb 

Thank you,

Mike Studios

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Dungeon Souls
notes.content:
Each week Marsh Davies wriggles free of his shackles and flees, filthy and naked, from the dank imprisonment of Early Access, bringing you stories of the depravities he endured therein. This week he s playing Dungeon Souls, a frenetic top-down roguelike in which the player battles through successive tiers of peril, nipping between abruptly spawning enemies and hails of magic bullets.

Titan Souls, Twin Souls, Crystal Souls, Crossing Souls… if Namco ever wanted to stake a claim to that Souls suffix, I suspect the horse has bolted, flown to Belize and can now be seen scooting round Tranquility Bay on a jetski, trying to clasp a pi a colada between its hooves. But whereas the lack of opposable thumbs ultimately renders this a tragic scene, the existence of Dungeon Souls should be one of celebration, derivative though it is, both in its name and in its action – which borrows heavily from both Nuclear Throne and Spelunky.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Dungeon Souls Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZDBnda5.png[/img]

Upon reviewing all comments and suggestions, our team has carefully kept an eye on every detail of your feedback. We are very pleased with your participation. Your insights were very helpful to our development.

Here’s Dungeon Souls Update #1:

- New Items!
- Pop-up will now be “BERSERK” instead of “SLOWED” in berserk mode. 
- Thief Dash was changed to “Thief Bomb” while Smoke Bomb was changed to “Invisibility.”
- Cleric’s description has been changed.
- Archer’s 3rd ability will be raining 10 arrows instead of 20 arrows.
- Key has been fixed when buying an item.
- Melee attacks will now destroy projectiles.
- Fixed the bug where your normal attack has no damage when you have Thornmail or Molotov.
- Soul Jar can now create more souls but will heal slower.
- Gold is not stashed anymore when in EASY difficulty.
- Soul orb is now required to rank up your character.
- You can now mute the game, disable screen shake and flashes.
- Details of the class abilities will now allow you to view them when hovered (in game).
- Ability icon dims when deactivated.

We are continuing to incorporate all your suggestions/comments so there will be more updates.

On behalf of our team, thank you very much.

Mike Studios
